summary: FDIC gives notice that it has established a new Privacy Act system of records for its e-rulemaking comments database. The notice describes how comment submissions are collected, stored and published, and invites comments by 2022-10-03 before routine uses become effective on 2022-10-03.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receivership
summary: The FDIC gives notice that it intends to terminate the receivership of The Enloe State Bank after liquidation of assets and final dividend processing. Interested parties may submit written comments within 30 days of the notice date; the termination is effective no sooner than 30 days after the notice.

title: Market Risk Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced a public Market Risk Advisory Committee meeting on 28 September 2022 and invited written statements by 5 October 2022. The agenda covers digital asset market risks, retail investor/customer protection, climate-related market risk, and market structure topics. This is an informational meeting notice, not a rule or requirement.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC published notice that it terminated receiverships for five insured depository institutions, effective 2022-09-01. The receiverships have been discharged and ceased to exist as legal entities. No ongoing compliance action is created for firms, but legal and operations teams may need to note the closure status.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Appraisals for Higher-Priced Mortgage Loans
summary: The OCC issued a notice seeking comments on renewal of an existing information collection for higher-priced mortgage loan appraisals under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2022-11-07. The notice restates the underlying appraisal disclosure and copy requirements for covered creditors, but it does not itself change those requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Joint Standards for Assessing the Diversity Policies and Practices of Entities Regulated by the Agencies and Diversity Self-Assessment Template for OCC-Regulated Entities
summary: The OCC published a 60-day notice seeking comment on renewal of an OMB information collection for OCC-regulated entities’ diversity policies and practices self-assessment template. Comments are due by 2022-11-07. This is a paperwork/administrative notice and does not itself change substantive requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB requests public comment on extending OMB approval for an existing Regulation I information collection for depository institutions lacking federal deposit insurance. It does not propose any new or revised disclosure requirements. Comments are due by 2022-11-08.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting on September 21, 2022, to consider enforcement matters. It is a notice of meeting logistics only and does not create obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The NCUA announced an open Board meeting for 22 September 2022 and listed agenda items including a Share Insurance Fund quarterly report and items on credit union bylaws, member expulsion, and subordinated debt. This is a notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that its Market Surveys information collection (OMB Control No. 3038-0017) is under OMB review and open for public comments until 2022-10-21. It does not change any substantive rule; it only seeks comment on an existing paperwork collection and burden estimate.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting
summary: The FDIC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting of its Board on September 20, 2022 to discuss supervision, corporate, and resolution matters. This is a meeting notice only and does not create or change any requirements for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC issued a Sunshine Act meeting notice updating the time and date of a previously announced closed meeting to 1:00 p.m. EDT on 27 September 2022. The meeting place and agenda were unchanged.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC announced termination of receiverships for six failed insured depository institutions, effective 2022-10-01. The notice confirms the receiver has completed winding up and related asset liquidation, and that the receiverships no longer exist as legal entities.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions list immediately and apply any required blocking/rejection measures.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List, meaning their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction are blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. This is effective immediately based on the stated OFAC determination date. Sanctions screening and blocking controls should be updated accordingly.

title: Supervisory Highlights, Issue 27, Fall 2022
summary: CFPB issued its Supervisory Highlights, Issue 27, summarizing supervisory findings on student loan servicers and private student loan practices. It discusses abusive transcript-withholding policies, risks from federal loan transfers, and servicing violations in PSLF, IDR and TLF administration. This is an informational supervisory publication only; it does not itself create new requirements or deadlines.

title: Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request
summary: NCUA published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It covers credit union fidelity bond/insurance reporting and NCUA personnel security forms, with comments due 2022-11-10. This is a comment request only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published new SDN designations under Executive Order 14014. The listed individuals and entity are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. Firms must screen and update sanctions controls immediately; the notice is effective from the designation date, October 6, 2022.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published names added to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions designations immediately. The notice is dated October 7, 2022 and was published October 13, 2022.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA published a Sunshine Act notice announcing an open Board meeting on October 19, 2022, including a briefing on the agency’s 2023-2024 budget. It is an informational notice only and does not impose obligations on firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA notice announcing an open Sunshine Act Board meeting on 2022-10-20, including agenda items on cybersecurity, the Central Liquidity Fund and the NCUA Risk Appetite Statement. It is informational only and does not itself create requirements.

title: Credit Union Advisory Council Meeting
summary: The CFPB announced a public meeting of its Credit Union Advisory Council on November 3, 2022. The notice provides logistics, RSVP and comment deadlines, and says the council will discuss broad policy matters related to the Bureau’s Unified Regulatory Agenda and authority. No rule or obligation is created.

title: Privacy Act of 1974: Systems of Records
summary: NCUA published a notice revising its Privacy Act system of records for examination and supervision files (NCUA-22). It adds meeting recordings and updates how the system is used for supervisory, enforcement, and legal actions. Comments were due by 2022-11-21, and the revision was set to become effective on that date absent contrary comments.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC published a Sunshine Act notice announcing a closed Commission meeting on October 27, 2022 to քննարկe examination matters. It is an informational notice only and does not create requirements for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting; Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days Advance Notice
summary: FDIC notice of a Board meeting held on short notice, listing agenda items including a final rule on deposit insurance assessments, a final rule on revised assessment rates, an ANPR on resolution-related resource requirements for large banking organizations, and proposed changes to appeals guidelines. This is a meeting notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC removed Terence Micallef from the SDN List and unblocked his property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction, effective October 17, 2022. This changes sanctions screening and asset-freezing obligations for U.S.-connected activity involving the named person.

title: Designated Reserve Ratio for 2023
summary: The FDIC published its annual notice that the Designated Reserve Ratio for the Deposit Insurance Fund will remain at 2% for 2023. This applies to FDIC-insured banks and affects deposit insurance fund assessment settings, with no amendment needed to the existing regulation.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added several individuals and entities to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059 for illicit drug trafficking activity. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective as of the designation date, 2022-10-19.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals and entities to the SDN List under E.O. 14024, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms should screen customers, counterparties and payments against the updated list immediately.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection on cross-border margin requirements for uncleared swaps has been sent to OMB for 30-day review and public comment. It concerns swap dealers and major swap participants, with comments due by 2022-11-25. This is a request for comment, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collections
summary: NCUA issued a notice and request for comment on extensions of three existing information collections for federal credit unions: records preservation, bylaws, and payments on shares by public units and nonmembers. Comments are due by 2022-12-27. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice and does not itself change substantive requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one individual and one Nicaraguan state-owned entity to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions list immediately; no future consultation or compliance date is stated.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC published a notice modifying its Privacy Act system of records FDIC-013, renaming it Financial Institution Resolution and Receivership Records, adding a new routine use, and updating retention and disposal practices. Comments were due by 2022-12-02, and the routine uses were set to become effective on 2022-12-02 unless changed after comment review. This mainly affects privacy and legal teams.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC published notice of a modified Privacy Act system of records for unclaimed deposit account records. It adds a new routine use to let members of the public locate and understand the status of accounts, with comment due by 2022-12-02 and the routine use effective on that date unless changed after comments.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was dated 2022-10-26; the notice was published on 2022-11-04.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published new SDN designations under U.S. sanctions authorities, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with the listed persons. Firms should screen the named parties and any related entities immediately; the notice is effective on the date stated in the sanctions action.

title: Notice and Request for Comment Regarding the CFPB's Inquiry Into Big Tech Payment Platforms
summary: The CFPB re-opened a 30-day comment period on its inquiry into big tech payment platforms in the United States and added two questions. Comments are due by 2022-12-07. This is an information-gathering notice, not a rule or supervisory requirement.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting on November 15, 2022 to consider enforcement matters. This is a meeting notice only and does not create new requirements or deadlines.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective November 4, 2022.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities. U.S. persons must block property and generally stop transactions with the listed parties immediately. Firms with U.S. nexus or sanctions screening obligations should update controls as of the effective date stated in the notice.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one individual and one company to the SDN List under Burma-related sanctions. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and any property or interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. Effective date is the designation date of 2022-11-08.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under North Korea sanctions, blocking their property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms should screen names and stop any dealings or assets connected to the designated persons immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added Tornado Cash and associated Ethereum addresses to the SDN List, blocking U.S.-jurisdiction property interests and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from transacting with the listed entity. This is effective immediately and affects sanctions screening, payments, and asset controls for any business dealing with crypto or cross-border counterparties.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receiverships
summary: The FDIC gives notice that it intends to terminate specified bank receiverships in the United States, with a 30-day comment window from the notice date. The receiverships have completed liquidation and final dividend payments may be made to proven creditors before termination becomes effective.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action notice naming persons added to the SDN List. Their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. No implementation date is stated beyond the notice’s effective action date in the supplementary information.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List and blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. No filing date is stated in the notice; the listed designations were determined on 2022-09-22.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List based on its determination that legal criteria were met. For U.S. persons, transactions with these persons are generally prohibited and property/interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. The notice is effective on the date(s) stated in the supplementary information section.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. As of 2022-11-16, their U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property are blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen against the updated list immediately and apply blocking/restrictions as applicable.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB requests public comment on a new Paperwork Reduction Act information collection covering foundational research on consumer credit markets and household financial decision-making. Comments are due by 2023-01-23. This is a notice seeking OMB approval, not a rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals and entities to the SDN List, blocking their property and prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms with sanctions screening, onboarding, payments, trade finance, or customer exposure to the listed parties should update controls immediately.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Joint Standards for Assessing the Diversity Policies and Practices of Entities Regulated by the Agencies and Diversity Self-Assessment, Template for OCC-Regulated Entities
summary: The OCC issued a 30-day notice and request for comment on renewal of an existing information collection for OCC-regulated entities’ voluntary diversity and inclusion self-assessment template. The only change described is converting the template from Excel to a fillable PDF. Comments are due by 2023-01-04.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC announced termination of receiverships for several failed insured depository institutions, effective 2022-12-01. The notice confirms the receiverships have been wound up, the receiver discharged, and the entities ceased to exist as legal entities. No new obligations are created for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was determined on 2022-12-01 and published on 2022-12-07.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen against the updated sanctions list and apply blocking/prohibition controls immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and a vessel to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities, blocking their property and interests in property within U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated list immediately and stop any prohibited activity involving the newly designated parties.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and linked vessels to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen and prevent dealings with the newly designated parties, effective from the designation date stated in the notice.

title: Notice of Availability of Revised Consumer Information Publication
summary: The CFPB announced an updated HELOC consumer booklet, available on its website and in Spanish. The notice explains the booklet’s revised content and encourages financial institutions to distribute it to consumers, but it does not create new obligations or set a compliance date.

title: Guidelines for Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
summary: The FDIC issued revised guidelines for appeals of material supervisory determinations for insured depository institutions. The changes add the Ombudsman as a non-voting SARC member, require timely sharing of appeal materials subject to legal limits, and allow institutions to request a stay while an appeal is pending. The revised guidelines became applicable on 2022-12-13.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC removed named persons and entities from the SDN List and unblocked their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction, effective December 16, 2022. Sanctions screening and customer/payment workflows should update immediately for the listed names and aliases.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC announced that two names were removed from the SDN List and their blocked property is unblocked. U.S. persons are no longer generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the date of the OFAC determination on 2022-12-28.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is requesting public comment on extending OMB approval for an existing consumer survey information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2023-03-13. The notice concerns research surveys using the Consumer Credit Panel and does not itself change obligations for firms.

title: Global Markets Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced a public meeting of its Global Markets Advisory Committee for 13 February 2023. The committee will discuss its structure, subcommittees and possible policy topics relating to global markets and international standards for futures, swaps, options and derivatives. Public written statements were requested by 20 February 2023.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on extending its information collection for registration under the Commodity Exchange Act, covering registration forms for intermediaries and other registrants. Comments are due by 2023-02-21. This is a paperwork/administrative notice, not a new rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an information collection on privacy of consumer financial information has been sent to OMB for 30-day review and comment. It concerns the extension of an existing PRA collection for CFTC-regulated firms subject to part 160, including privacy and opt-out notices and safeguards. Comments are due by 2023-02-21.

title: Request for Information Regarding Consumer Credit Card Market
summary: The CFPB is seeking public comments for its next review of the consumer credit card market under the CARD Act. Comments are due by 2023-04-24. This is a request for information only and does not itself change obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms need to screen for matches and apply blocking/rejection controls immediately; the action was determined on 2023-01-24 and published on 2023-01-27.

title: Joint Report: Differences in Accounting and Capital Standards Among the Federal Banking Agencies as of September 30, 2022; Report to Congressional Committees
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC published their annual report to Congress on differences in accounting and capital standards as of September 30, 2022. It says no material differences were identified among the agencies’ standards for the institutions they supervise. This is informational only and does not impose new requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice naming persons added to the SDN List. Their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Effective dates are stated in the supplementary information, not in the excerpt.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List by adding one or more persons and related property to its sanctions list. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective on the dates stated in the notice.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published new SDN designations on 2023-02-01. The named individuals and entities are blocked under U.S. jurisdiction, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen counterparties and update sanctions controls immediately.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receiverships
summary: The FDIC gives notice that it intends to terminate receiverships for a list of failed banks after liquidation is complete. Comments must be submitted in writing within 30 days of the notice date; the termination becomes effective no sooner than 30 days after the notice date. This is an informational market/operational notice, not a new rule.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen immediately and apply any required blocking/rejection controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added several individuals and Burmese entities to the SDN List under E.O. 14014. U.S. property interests in the listed parties are blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Banks and other firms should screen immediately and apply sanctions controls from the designation date noted in the notice.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The CFPB requests comment on extending OMB approval for the existing Regulation X information collection under RESPA. It does not change the rule itself or create new obligations; comments are due by 2023-04-10.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN entry for one Mexico-based individual under Executive Order 14059 relating to illicit drugs. Firms must ensure screening and blocking controls reflect the revised identifying information immediately. The notice is effective on the date OFAC updated the listing, February 1, 2023.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting on February 15, 2023 to consider enforcement matters. It is a public meeting notice only and does not create new obligations for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced an open Sunshine Act meeting for 15 February 2023. The meeting agenda includes an advance notice of proposed rulemaking on risk management program regulations for swap dealers, major swap participants and futures commission merchants, and an order on product identifiers and classification for recordkeeping and swap data reporting.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added seven individuals to the SDN List under U.S. cyber sanctions authority. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. Effective date is tied to the supplemental information referenced in the notice; monitor immediately for screening and payment impacts.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA announced an open Sunshine Act Board meeting on 16 February 2023 to discuss, among other topics, the federal credit union loan interest rate ceiling, chartering and field of membership, and cyber incident notification requirements. This is a meeting notice only and does not itself change any requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a change to the location of a previously scheduled Sunshine Act meeting; it will now be held virtually on the same date and time. No substantive regulatory requirements are created or changed.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. For U.S. persons, dealings with the listed persons are generally prohibited and any property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective as stated in the notice.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published notice that one or more persons were added to the SDN List on 2023-02-10. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen against the updated sanctions list immediately.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced that a previously scheduled Sunshine Act Commission meeting was canceled. This is informational only and creates no regulatory requirements for firms.

title: Market Risk Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced a public meeting of its Market Risk Advisory Committee on March 8, 2023. The committee will discuss CCP risk and governance, interest rate benchmark reform, climate-related risk, market structure, and emerging technologies. Members of the public may submit written statements by March 15, 2023.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on extending OMB approval for an existing information collection tied to its Your Money, Your Goals financial empowerment training program. Comments are due by 2023-03-27. This is a public comment request only; it does not itself change obligations for firms.

title: Request for Nominations for the Global Market Structure Subcommittee, Digital Asset Markets Subcommittee, and Technical Issues Subcommittee Under the Global Markets Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC is requesting nominations by 2023-03-14 for membership on three advisory subcommittees covering global market structure, digital asset markets, and technical issues. The notice explains the subcommittees will provide reports and recommendations to the GMAC, not direct decisions, and that service is unpaid.

title: Technology Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced a public meeting of its Technology Advisory Committee on March 22, 2023, to discuss the committee’s structure, subcommittees, and possible topics for policy recommendations on technology in financial services, derivatives, and commodity markets. Written statements were due by March 29, 2023. This is an informational meeting notice, not a rule or guidance update.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and updated identifying information for five existing entries. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with these parties and property within U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective from the listed designation date of 2023-02-24, with the notice published on 2023-03-08.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Renewal; Comment Request: Renewal Without Change of Information Collection Requirements in Connection With the Imposition of the Fifth Special Measure Against the Islamic Republic of Iran as a Jurisdiction of Primary Money Laundering Concern
summary: FinCEN is seeking comments by 2023-05-08 on renewing, without change, the information collection tied to the fifth special measure against Iran under 31 CFR 1010.661. The underlying special-measure requirements remain unchanged; this notice only invites public comment on the PRA renewal for U.S. financial institutions subject to the Iran correspondent-account restrictions.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published updates to the SDN List, designating new persons and updating one existing entry. title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is seeking comments on extending OMB approval for an existing consumer complaint feedback survey under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The notice relates to the consumer complaint process and asks for comments by 2023-05-08, but it does not itself change any obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. This is effective based on the stated designation date of March 3, 2023.

title: Appraisal Subcommittee Notice of Meeting
summary: The Appraisal Subcommittee announced a public open meeting on March 15, 2023, and provided attendance and webcast instructions. No regulatory requirements, deadlines, or policy changes were announced.

title: Renewal of Credit Union Advisory Council
summary: The CFPB announced it will renew the Credit Union Advisory Council, a non-binding advisory body for the Bureau. It is effective March 15, 2023 and is limited to employees of credit unions with $10 billion or less in assets. No new regulatory requirements are created for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions

summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities. The notice is effective as of the stated OFAC determination date, with no consultation or transition period.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public notice listing banks for which it has been appointed receiver. It identifies Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank as in liquidation, effective on their stated closing dates. This is an informational record of receivership status, not a new rule, with immediate relevance for operations and legal reference.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a change to the timing of a previously scheduled Sunshine Act Commission meeting. The meeting remains closed and otherwise unchanged; this is for information only and creates no new regulatory requirements.

title: Mutual Savings Association Advisory Committee
summary: The OCC announced a public meeting of its Mutual Savings Association Advisory Committee on April 4, 2023. The committee will advise the OCC on possible regulatory or other changes affecting mutual savings associations, and the public may submit written statements by March 30, 2023.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Information Collection: Appraiser Profession Survey
summary: The FFIEC Appraisal Subcommittee issued a notice seeking public comment on a proposed new Appraiser Profession Survey and its related information collection request to OMB. Comments are due by 2023-05-22. The notice is for awareness and input only; it does not itself impose new requirements on firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added several persons to the SDN List on 2023-03-21, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from transacting with them. title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one individual to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction, with U.S. persons generally prohibited from dealings. title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 14014 related to Burma. U.S. persons must not deal with the listed parties and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked immediately. The notice is effective from the designated dates stated in the supplemental information and applies to any firms with U.S. touchpoints or USD exposure.

title: Community Development Revolving Loan Fund Access for Credit Unions
summary: NCUA issued a notice of funding opportunity for 2023 Community Development Revolving Loan Fund grants to eligible low-income designated and minority depository institution credit unions. It describes grant purposes, eligibility limits, and application materials, but does not itself impose a new rule or compliance deadline. Credit unions interested in funding should review the grant round guidelines and NCUA materials.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB published a notice requesting public comment on a proposed information collection for a study on borrower race bias in mortgage loan judgments. Comments were due by 2023-05-01. This is a PRA notice seeking OMB approval, not a rule or binding requirement.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The notice is effective on the dates stated in the accompanying OFAC action details.

Firms should screen for the new name and apply blocking/rejection controls where relevant.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFTC is creating a new Privacy Act system of records for its Office of Inspector General audit files, with routine uses effective 2023-05-05 and comments due by 2023-05-05. It covers audit work papers and related personal information about CFTC participants, staff, contractors and other related individuals.

title: Minority Depository Institutions Advisory Committee
summary: The OCC announced a public meeting of the Minority Depository Institutions Advisory Committee on 2023-04-25 and invited written statements by 2023-04-20. The notice is informational and does not itself create new requirements for banks.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: FDIC published a notice terminating receiverships for nine failed insured depository institutions, effective April 1, 2023. The notice says the receiver has completed required dividend distributions and the receiverships have ceased to exist as legal entities. This affects firms dealing with the named institutions and related records or asset transfers.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one entity to the SDN List, blocking its property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with it. Firms must screen for the named party and any 50% or more owned subsidiaries and apply sanctions controls immediately; the action was determined on 2023-03-31 and published on 2023-04-11.

title: Privacy Act of 1974: Systems of Records
summary: NCUA gave notice of a new Privacy Act system of records, NCUA-26, covering background and fitness information for prospective officials and employees of proposed federal and federally insured state-chartered credit unions. Comments are due by 2023-05-15. The system is effective immediately, with routine uses effective on 2023-05-15.

title: FDIC Systemic Resolution Advisory Committee; Notice of Charter Renewal
summary: The FDIC renewed the charter of its Systemic Resolution Advisory Committee under FACA. The committee will continue advising the FDIC on resolution-related issues for systemically important financial companies, but the notice does not create new requirements or deadlines for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB issued a notice requesting public comment on a proposed information collection for the “Junk Fees Timing Study” under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments were due by 2023-05-18. This is a solicitation for OMB approval of a study, not a rule or binding requirement.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act notice announcing a closed Board meeting held on April 18, 2023 to discuss supervision, corporate, and resolution matters. It is informational only and creates no new requirements or deadlines.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC proposes changes to Privacy Act system-of-records notice FDIC-010 for OIG investigative files, including new record categories, third-party secure storage, and revised routine uses. Comments are due by 2023-05-30, and the routine uses would become effective on that date unless changed after comments. This affects privacy and legal teams, especially for information sharing and record handling.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Renew Collection 3038-0072, Registration of Swap Dealers and Major Swap Participants
summary: The CFTC published a notice seeking public comment on renewing an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for swap dealer and major swap participant registration. Comments are due by 2023-06-27. The notice does not itself change registration requirements; it is an administrative consultation on the information collection burden.

title: Combined Community Bank Advisory Council and Credit Union Advisory Council Meeting
summary: The CFPB announced a public combined meeting of its Community Bank Advisory Council and Credit Union Advisory Council on May 17, 2023. The councils will discuss broad policy matters and the Bureau’s Unified Regulatory Agenda. This is a notice of meeting only and does not itself create new requirements.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC is creating a new Privacy Act system of records, FDIC-041, for information used to approve, monitor and disable access to FDIC IT resources. It covers FDIC staff, contractors, volunteers, interns, regulators, financial institution employees and members of the public. The notice became effective May 2, 2023, and comments on the routine uses were due by June 1, 2023.

Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-07-31. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC removed named individuals and an entity from the SDN List on 2025-05-28, so their property and interests in property are no longer blocked under the cited sanctions authorities. Sanctions screening, blocking, and customer/client record checks should be updated immediately for any exposure to the named parties.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application involving shares of Cumberland Valley Financial Corporation and its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may comment by 2025-07-16. This is a public notice, not a rule or decision.

title: Guidance on Referrals for Potential Criminal Enforcement
summary: The NCUA published a notice describing its plan for handling potential criminal regulatory offenses under Executive Order 14294. It says it will prepare a report by 2026 and gives factors staff should consider before referring alleged offenses to DOJ. This is an informational policy notice and does not itself create new compliance obligations.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices for proposed acquisitions or retention of voting shares in two bank groups. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-07-17. This is a notice of pending ownership-control applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public list of financial institutions for which it has been appointed receiver or liquidator, adding The Santa Anna National Bank with a closed date of 2025-06-27. This is an informational receiver/liquidation notice, not a new rule. Firms may use it as of-record notice of FDIC receivership status.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added four individuals and four entities to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-07-01 and published on 2025-07-03.

title: Chartering and Field of Membership-Public Hearing; Community Charter Application for Area With a Population of 2.5 Million or More
summary: NCUA has issued a notice of public hearing on Dade County Federal Credit Union’s request to expand its community charter to a proposed area with a population over 2.5 million. Interested parties may register and submit comments by 2025-08-26, and the hearing will take place on 2025-09-23. The notice describes hearing procedures and does not itself change any requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company application filings, inviting public comments by 2025-08-08 on proposed formations and acquisitions in Kansas. It lists two applicants seeking approval under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company acquisition application. Security State Agency of Aitkin, Inc. has applied to acquire Randall Bancorp, Inc. and indirectly Randall State Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2025-08-11.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: FDIC announced an open Board meeting for July 15, 2025, to discuss several items, including proposed amendments to appeals guidance, proposed rulemakings on FDIC regulatory thresholds, CRA regulations, and branch establishment/relocation, plus an RFI on industrial banks. This is a meeting notice only; it does not itself create obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Effective July 9, 2025. Sanctions screening and transaction controls should be updated immediately.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFPB published a notice modifying its Privacy Act system of records for advisory boards and committees, mainly updating the categories of records example from “gender” to “sex.” Comments are due by 2025-08-14, and the modified system is effective on 2025-08-25 unless comments change the outcome.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFPB has published a notice modifying its Privacy Act system of records for Supervision and Examination Records, changing a demographic example from “gender” to “sex.” Comments are due by 2025-08-14, and the modified system becomes effective on 2025-08-25 unless comments lead to a contrary determination.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comments by 2025-09-15 on extending, without revision, its Intermittent Survey of Businesses information collection for three years. The proposal concerns the PRA burden estimate and survey design, and does not itself change substantive reporting obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of bank holding company merger/acquisition applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the application by 2025-08-15. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule change, and it affects bank holding companies and related banking acquisitions in the US.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Huntington Bancshares has applied to acquire Veritex Holdings and indirectly Veritex Community Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-08-18. This is an application notice, not a rule or approval.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act notice for a closed Board meeting held on July 15, 2025. The notice states the Board considered matters relating to the Corporation’s resolution, supervision and corporate activities. It is informational only and creates no new requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications for bank holding company formation and acquisition, inviting public comments on the Bancshares of Carolina proposal to become a bank holding company by acquiring The Bank of Clarendon. Comments must be received by 2025-08-18. This is an application notice, not a rule change.

title: Guidelines for Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
summary: The FDIC proposes to amend its appeals guidelines to replace the current Supervision Appeals Review Committee with an independent Office of Supervisory Appeals that would hear material supervisory appeals for insured depository institutions. Comments are due by 2025-09-16. This is a proposal, not a final rule, so firms should review and consider submitting input rather than implementing changes yet.

title: Request for Information on Industrial Banks and Industrial Loan Companies and Their Parent Companies
summary: The FDIC is seeking comments on its approach to evaluating statutory factors for industrial bank and industrial loan company filings, including applications for deposit insurance and certain corporate transactions. Comments are due by 2025-09-19. The request is aimed at companies that own or may seek to own industrial banks, and may inform future changes to FDIC review practices.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for persons seeking to acquire shares of Fishback Financial Corporation and indirectly First Bank & Trust. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-08-11. The notice is informational and does not itself approve or impose new requirements.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel's Joint Committee
summary: The IRS announced an open virtual meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel’s Joint Committee on 2025-08-28. The notice invites public comments and registration by 2025-08-21, but it does not create or change any obligations for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List and revised a blocked vessel entry. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with the listed parties, and any property or interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. Effective on the June 18, 2025 action date, with publication on July 28, 2025.

title: Request for Expressions of Interest in Membership on the Federal Insurance Office's Advisory Committee on Risk-Sharing Mechanisms
summary: Treasury’s Federal Insurance Office is seeking expressions of interest for membership on its Advisory Committee on Risk-Sharing Mechanisms. Interested individuals must apply by 2025-08-29 and may be subject to conflict-of-interest and pre-appointment background checks.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of company proposals for bank holding companies to engage in or acquire permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y and the Bank Holding Company Act. The notice invites public comments by 2025-08-29 on whether the proposals meet section 4 standards. It affects the named US bank holding companies and related acquisitions, but it does not itself create new requirements.

title: Prompt Payment Interest Rate; Contract Disputes Act
summary: The US Treasury’s Bureau of the Fiscal Service set the prompt payment interest rate at 4% per annum for late-payment interest under the Prompt Payment Act and Contract Disputes Act, applicable from 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31. Firms that contract with US agencies should use this rate for calculating late-payment interest during that period.

title: List of Countries Requiring Cooperation With an International Boycott
summary: The U.S. Treasury published an updated list of countries that may require participation in or cooperation with an international boycott under section 999 of the Internal Revenue Code. The list includes Iraq, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Syria and Yemen. This is an informational notice only and does not itself impose new requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice inviting comments on an application by Rhineland Bancshares, Inc. to merge with Green City Bancshares Inc. and indirectly acquire Farmbank. Interested persons may submit views on the statutory standards by 2025-09-02. This is a public notice of a pending bank holding company transaction, not a final approval.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Bureau of Fiscal Service Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury Department published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking public comment on several Bureau of the Fiscal Service information collection requests before submitting them to OMB. It concerns extension of existing forms used for EFT trace requests and estate-related Treasury securities/payment matters, with comments due by 2025-09-02.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added CARTEL DE LOS SOLES to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealings with the entity. Firms should screen for matches and stop prohibited transactions immediately. The action was issued on 2025-07-25 and published on 2025-08-04.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a change-in-bank-control notice for a proposed retention of voting shares in Purdy Bancshares, Inc. and indirectly First State Bank of Purdy. Interested persons may comment by 2025-08-19. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a new rule or enforcement action.

title: Appraisal Subcommittee; Notice Of Meeting
summary: The Appraisal Subcommittee announced that it held special closed meetings on April 24, 2025 and July 14, 2025 to discuss a personnel matter. No action was taken and the notice creates no new requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that identified applicants seeking approval under the Change in Bank Control Act to acquire shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-08-20. The notice concerns Devon Bancorp, Inc. and Devon Bank in Chicago.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-07-31 and published on 2025-08-05.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on an application by Bank Forward Employee Stock Ownership Plan and Trust to acquire up to 45.45% of Security State Bank Holding Company and indirectly Bank Forward. Comments must be received by 2025-09-04. This is a notice of a pending bank holding company acquisition, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a bank control notice inviting public comments on an application to retain voting shares of a bank holding company and its bank subsidiary. Comments must be received by 2025-08-21. This is a notice of a pending ownership/control application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 14059 and E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Banks and other U.S.-linked firms must screen and apply sanctions controls immediately from the August 6, 2025 action date.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: FDIC issued a notice requesting public comment on renewal of two existing information collections: Community Reinvestment Act and Qualifications for Failed Bank Acquisitions. Comments are due by 2025-10-10. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice; it does not itself change substantive requirements, but it describes current reporting, recordkeeping and disclosure burdens for affected FDIC-supervised institutions and investors.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and vessels to the SDN List under Iran sanctions authorities, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The notice was issued on 2025-07-30 and published on 2025-08-12. Screeners, sanctions compliance, onboarding and payments teams should update controls immediately.

title: Solicitation of Statements of Interest for Membership on the Insurance Policy Advisory Committee
summary: The Federal Reserve issued a notice inviting individuals to submit statements of interest for possible membership on its Insurance Policy Advisory Committee. Statements are accepted annually during the first Monday in August through the first Monday in October for consideration in appointments announced later that year.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for persons seeking to acquire or retain voting shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-08-28. This is a notice of filings and comment period, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFPB proposes to rescind its Privacy Act system of records notice for CFPB.023 Prize Competitions Program Records. Comments are due by 2025-09-15, and the rescindment would become effective on 2025-09-23 unless comments change the outcome. The notice affects the CFPB’s privacy recordkeeping, not external firms.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Ethylene-Propylene-Dicyclopentadiene Rubber (m=73.18, n=26.53, o=0.29)
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add ethylene-propylene-dicyclopentadiene rubber to the Superfund tax list of taxable substances. This is not a final determination. Comments or hearing requests are due by 2025-10-14.

title: Corporation To Do Business Under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Shermen Holdings, Inc. has applied to establish Shermen Bank International as an Edge Corporation under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act and Regulation K. Interested persons may comment by 2025-09-02. This is a notice of an authorisation application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Orders 14059 and 13224, blocking their property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealings with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions names and block/reject any impacted activity immediately; the notice was issued on 2025-08-13 and published on 2025-08-15.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving public notice of a bank holding company application by Community Bancshares of Mississippi, Inc. Employee Stock Ownership Plan to acquire additional voting shares and indirectly acquire Community Bank of Mississippi. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-09-15.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments on the applications by 2025-09-17. This is a procedural notice about pending approvals for bank holding company and bank acquisitions, not a new rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice listing bank holding company formation, acquisition and merger applications for public comment. Interested persons may submit comments on the applications by 2025-09-18. This is an application notice only; it does not itself approve or change requirements for banks or bank holding companies.

title: Agency Collection Activities; Requesting Comments on Form 5306 Application for Approval of Prototype or Employer Sponsored Individual Retirement Account
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection for Form 5306, used by employers, banks and insurance companies to apply for approval of prototype or employer-sponsored individual retirement accounts or annuities. This is an extension of a currently approved collection with no change to the paperwork burden. Comments are due by 2025-10-20.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Form 8955-SSA
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for Form 8955-SSA, used by plan administrators to report separated participants with deferred vested benefits. There is no change to the form or reporting requirement, and comments are due by 2025-10-20.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is inviting public comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application to retain voting shares of a bank holding company and indirectly its bank subsidiary. Affected persons may submit comments by 2025-09-11. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. It invites public comments on the listed transactions by 2025-09-29. This is an information notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquiring or retaining voting shares in two U.S. bank holding company groups. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-09-15. This is a public notice and comment request, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury Department is seeking public comment on multiple TTB information collection requests for OMB review under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The notice covers existing collections on alcohol and tobacco permit financial disclosures, alcohol labeling and advertising, and drawback recordkeeping. Comments are due by 2025-09-29.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Certification of Material Events Form
summary: Treasury is asking for public comment on a revised CDFI Fund information collection form for reporting material events. The notice affects certified CDFIs, recipients and allocatees participating in CDFI Fund programs, with comments due by 2025-09-29. No substantive new reporting rule is adopted in this notice.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB has published a notice inviting public comments on an application by East Texas Financial Corporation to acquire Texas National Bancorporation and indirectly Texas National Bank of Jacksonville. Comments must be submitted by 2025-10-02. This is a bank holding company application notice, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Revenue Procedure 2001-29, Leveraged Leases
summary: The IRS issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking public comments by 2025-11-03 on an unchanged information collection tied to Revenue Procedure 2001-29 for leveraged-lease advanced ruling requests. It does not change substantive rules; it only seeks input on burden and utility estimates.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company application activity: Southern Bancorp, Inc. seeks approval to acquire Ozarks Heritage Financial Group, Inc. and indirectly Legacy Bank & Trust Company. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-03.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Savings and Loan Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a change in bank control notice for acquisitions of shares of a savings and loan holding company. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-09-18. This is a notice and comment process, not a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC published a notice terminating the receivership of National Republic Bank of Chicago, effective 2025-09-01. The receivership has been discharged and ceased to exist as a legal entity. This is an informational notice only and does not impose new requirements on firms.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company merger applications and invited public comments by 2025-10-06. It concerns companies seeking approval to become or acquire a bank holding company under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. This is an awareness item for affected firms and their legal/regulatory teams; it does not itself grant approval or impose new rules.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act for several family groups seeking to acquire or retain voting shares in specific banks and bank holding companies. Interested persons may comment by 2025-09-19. This is a notice, not a rule or decision.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-08-27 and published on 2025-09-04.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on an application by MountainOne Financial, MHC and MountainOne Financial, Inc. to merge with Mechanics Bancorp, MHC and Mechanics Bancorp, Inc. and indirectly acquire Mechanics Cooperative Bank. Comments are due by 2025-10-08. This is a process notice, not an approval or rule change.

title: Policy Statement Concerning Agency Referrals for Potential Criminal Enforcement
summary: The CFTC issued a policy statement, effective 2025-09-10, describing how staff should consider referring potential criminal regulatory offenses to the Department of Justice. It also says the Commission will provide OMB a report by 2026-05-09 listing criminal regulatory offenses, penalties and mens rea standards. This is guidance only and does not itself create new obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated names immediately; the action was issued on 2025-09-08 and published on 2025-09-10.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a Change in Bank Control notice for proposed acquisitions/retentions of voting shares in a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-09-26. This is a notice of an application process, not a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel's Joint Committee
summary: The IRS Taxpayer Advocacy Panel’s Joint Committee will hold an open virtual meeting on 2025-09-25 to discuss customer-service issues and hear public comments. Anyone wishing to attend or speak must register by 2025-09-18. This is an informational meeting notice only and does not create regulatory obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is notifying the public of a bank holding company application and inviting comments by 2025-10-14. First Federal Community, MHC proposes to become a bank holding company by acquiring First Federal Community Bank, SSB in Paris, Texas. This is a notice of a pending perimeter/authorisation decision, not an approval or rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Heavy Highway Vehicle Use Tax Return
summary: The IRS is asking for public comments on a revised information collection for Heavy Highway Vehicle Use Tax Return Forms 2290 and 2290-SP. Comments are due by 2025-11-14. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice about burden estimates and form revisions, not a substantive tax rule change.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA announced an open Board meeting on September 18, 2025, including a briefing on the Share Insurance Fund quarterly report. This is an informational meeting notice only and does not create new requirements or deadlines.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Notice of Determinations To Add Substances to List of Taxable Substances
summary: The IRS/Treasury adds 39 chemical substances to the US Superfund taxable substances list. For importers, the section 4671 excise tax applies from 2026-01-01; refund-claim effective dates vary by substance. Importers and exporters should update tax, customs and product-master controls.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for proposed acquisitions of shares in two bank holding companies and indirect acquisitions/retentions of their banks. Interested persons may comment by 2025-10-02. This is an application notice, not a rule change, and it affects US banks and bank holding companies involved in the transactions.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for comments on proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and its bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-06. This is a public notice of a pending control application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that PNC Financial Services Group and its merger subsidiary have applied to acquire FirstBank Holding Company and indirectly FirstBank under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-20. This is a public applications notice, not a rule change.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for persons seeking to retain voting shares of a bank holding company and indirectly its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may comment by 2025-10-08. This is a public notice of a control application, not a rule change.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of a bank holding company proposal to engage de novo in, or acquire, a permissible nonbanking activity under Section 4 of the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2025-10-08. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change.

title: Amendment of Notice of Funds Availability for Native American CDFI Assistance Program; Revised Application Submission Deadline
summary: The Treasury CDFI Fund amended its Native American CDFI Assistance Program notice of funding availability. It removed climate-focused financing and some race-based eligible market references, revised the healthy foods definition, and set 27 October 2025 as the deadline for invited applicants to submit updates to their applications.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 13818. U.S. persons must treat their property as blocked and avoid dealings with them immediately. Banks with U.S. nexus or U.S.-dollar flows should screen and block any matches now.

title: Amendment of Notice of Funds Availability for Community Development Financial Institutions Program; Revised Application Submission Deadline
summary: The Treasury CDFI Fund amended its 2025 CDFI Program funding notice, removing climate-focused financing and some race-based eligible-market references, and revising the healthy foods definition. Applicants already submitted do not need to reapply, but those invited to update step-4 applications must do so by 2025-10-27.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for the Katz Family Group to acquire voting shares of Resource Bancshares and indirectly Resource Bank, National Association. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-14. This is a public notice of a pending ownership change, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Bureau of Engraving and Printing Features of Interest Survey for Banknote Equipment Manufacturers
summary: The Bureau of Engraving and Printing is seeking public comments on a proposed extension without change of its banknote equipment manufacturers survey under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2025-11-25. The survey is voluntary and used to inform future Federal Reserve Note redesign features.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The IRS is proposing a new computer matching program under the Privacy Act to support insider-risk monitoring. It will use specified Treasury and IRS records to detect and mitigate insider threats involving employees, contractors and other individuals. Comments are due within 30 days of Federal Register publication; if no comments are received, the agreement becomes effective on 2025-10-29.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application by Marquette Mutual Holding Company to become a bank holding company by acquiring Marquette Savings Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-29. This is a notice of an application and comment opportunity, not a final approval or rule change.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a Change in Bank Control Act notice for an application to retain shares of a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-10-15. This is a notice about a control-change filing, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Proposed Collection of Information: Accounts Receivable Forms for Debt Repayment
summary: The U.S. Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for accounts receivable debt repayment forms, including ACH payment setup and debtor financial information. Comments are due by 2025-12-01. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a rulemaking or binding requirement.

title: 2025 Community Development Revolving Loan Fund
summary: NCUA issued a notice of funding opportunity for 2025 technical assistance grants under the Community Development Revolving Loan Fund. It is open to eligible low-income-designated credit unions and sets application rules, eligibility criteria, and deadlines. Applications open 2025-10-15 and close 2025-12-16; inquiries close 2025-12-09.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals and one India-based company to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked, effective from 2025-09-24. Sanctions screening, blocking, and escalation processes should be updated immediately.

title: The NCUA Staff Draft 2026-2027 Budget
summary: The NCUA published its staff draft 2026-2027 budget for public review and invited comments. It also set a public hearing for November 6, 2025, with requests to speak due October 30, 2025, written statements due November 3, 2025, and written comments due November 7, 2025.

title: The NCUA Staff Draft 2026-2027 Budget
summary: The NCUA rescheduled the public hearing on its staff draft 2026-2027 budget from November 6, 2025 to November 5, 2025 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern. No substantive budget requirements changed; all other details and deadlines remain as previously published.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Ongoing Data Collection of Centrally Cleared Transactions in the U.S. Repurchase Agreement Market
