summary: The Treasury Department is seeking public comment on an OMB information collection renewal for ongoing daily reporting of centrally cleared U.S. repo transactions. The collection, used by the Office of Financial Research to monitor financial stability and support SOFR/BGCR calculations, would continue for certain U.S. CCPs if renewed. Comments are due by 2025-12-01.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA announced an open Sunshine Act meeting on November 5, 2025 to discuss the agency’s 2026-2027 budget. This is a public meeting notice only; it does not create obligations for regulated firms.

title: Notice of Meeting
summary: The U.S. Mint announced a public Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee meeting on November 18, 2025 to discuss several coin and medal design portfolios. It is an informational notice only; no regulatory requirements are created for firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Savings and Loan Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a proposed change in bank control involving acquisition of voting shares in a savings and loan holding company and its bank subsidiary. Comments must be received by 2025-11-28. This is an application/public notice rather than a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing pending applications for bank holding company formations, acquisitions, and mergers under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-12-12. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of Change in Bank Control Act filings for proposed acquisitions or retention of voting shares in various banks and bank holding companies. Interested persons may submit written comments by 2025-11-28. This is a notice of applications and comment period, not a final decision or rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List and updating identifying information for one listed person. U.S. property interests of the listed persons are blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date of 2025-11-04.

title: Federal Reserve Action To Expand Fedwirer® Funds Service and National Settlement Service Operating Hours
summary: The Federal Reserve announced it will expand Fedwire Funds Service hours to 22x6 and NSS hours to 21.5 hours per day, with implementation expected in 2028 or 2029. This is a service announcement, not a rule, and it has no immediate compliance deadline. Banks using U.S. payment rails should monitor the planned change and assess operational readiness.

title: Revisions to the Large Financial Institution Rating System and Framework for the Supervision of Insurance Organizations
summary: The Federal Reserve has issued a final notice revising its Large Financial Institution rating system and insurance organization supervisory framework. It changes how firms are assessed as “well managed,” removes the prior presumption of enforcement action for Deficient-1 ratings, and deletes a reputational risk reference in the insurance framework. It is effective 2026-01-16 and applies to covered bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, and certain U.S. intermediate holding companies.

title: Quarterly Publication of Individuals, Who Have Chosen To Expatriate
summary: IRS notice publishing the quarterly list of individuals who expatriated from U.S. citizenship for the quarter ending 2025-09-30, as required by IRC section 6039G. It is an informational publication and does not impose new obligations on firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and property in the United States or under U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective from the action date of 2025-10-24.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added four individuals linked to a transnational criminal organization to the SDN List. Their U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date of 2025-10-30.

title: Interest Rate Paid on Cash Deposited To Secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Immigration Bonds
summary: Treasury announced the interest rate on cash deposited to secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement immigration bonds for the period October 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026. The rate is 3% per annum. This is a published notice only and does not impose new compliance requirements.

title: Rescission of Principles for Climate-Related Financial Risk Management for Large Financial Institutions
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC rescind their interagency principles for climate-related financial risk management for large financial institutions, effective 2025-11-18. The rescission affects institutions over $100 billion in assets that had been in scope of the 2023 guidance, but it does not create new obligations or prohibit consideration of climate risk.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and entities to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-11-13 and published on 2025-11-19. Sanctions screening and transaction controls should be updated immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property within U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The notice states the action was issued on 2025-10-14 and published on 2025-11-19. Financial crime screening and sanctions controls should be updated immediately.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel's Joint Committee
summary: The IRS Taxpayer Advocacy Panel announced an open virtual meeting of its Joint Committee Project Committee on November 25, 2025. The notice invites public comments and registrations by November 21, 2025, but does not create or change any regulatory requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated identifying information for one or more SDN List entries, keeping their property and interests in property blocked under U.S. sanctions. Firms with sanctions screening, name-matching, onboarding, payments, or customer due diligence processes should reflect the revised SDN details immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List. Their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. This is effective immediately from the action date stated in the notice.

title: Senior Executive Service Performance Review Board Membership
summary: The Treasury Office of Inspector General announced the members of its Senior Executive Service Performance Review Board. This is an internal personnel notice about review and pay recommendation governance, with no new obligations for firms.

title: Senior Executive Service Performance Review Boards
summary: The Treasury Department published a notice appointing members to its Senior Executive Service Performance Review Boards. The boards review performance appraisals, ratings, bonuses and related personnel actions for Treasury SES incumbents, effective on the date of the notice.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Primary Dealer Meeting Agenda
summary: The U.S. Treasury is seeking comments by 2026-01-23 on an extension without change of the Primary Dealer Meeting Agenda information collection. It affects primary dealers, which are financial institutions, and relates to quarterly survey reporting to Treasury under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Stress Testing Rules for National Banks and Federal Savings Associations
summary: The OCC is seeking comment on renewal of its Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for stress testing rules covering national banks and federal savings associations. This is a notice-only action with a comment deadline of 2026-01-23; it does not itself change the underlying stress testing requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Timely Mailing Treated as Timely Filing
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for ‘Timely Mailing Treated as Timely Filing’ under the Paperwork Reduction Act. There is no change to the collection or underlying requirements; comments are due by 2026-01-23.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; States Where Licensed for Surety
summary: Treasury published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on an existing information collection, States Where Licensed for Surety, before submitting it to OMB for renewal without change. Insurance companies and other for-profits affected by the form may comment by 2025-12-26. No new substantive requirements are created.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-11-06 and is effective immediately for U.S.-jurisdiction property and dealings.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Vehicle Loan Interest Statement
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on a revised information collection for Vehicle Loan Interest Statement reporting under section 6050AA, including Form 1098-VLI. Comments are due by 2026-01-26. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice only; it does not itself create new filing obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury Department is seeking public comments for OMB review of several IRS information collection requests, including IRA prototype approvals, electronic filing authorisations, customer surveys, and records-production procedures. Comments are due by 2025-12-26. The notice itself does not impose new requirements; it is a Paperwork Reduction Act consultation.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is seeking public comment on extending OMB approval for its existing Consumer Response Intake Form under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The form is used by consumers to submit complaints, inquiries and feedback; comments are due by 2026-01-27. This notice does not itself change substantive requirements for firms.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Description of United States Savings Bonds Series HH/H and Description of United States Bonds/Notes
summary: The U.S. Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on extending an existing information collection for forms describing U.S. Savings Bonds and U.S. Bonds/Notes. Comments are due by 2026-01-27. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a new obligation rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Revision of an Approved Information Collection; Comment Request; Company-Run Annual Stress Test Reporting Template and Documentation for Covered Institutions With Total Consolidated Assets of $250 Billion or More Under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
summary: The OCC is asking for public comment on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for company-run annual stress test reporting by covered institutions with $250 billion or more in consolidated assets. Comments are due by 2026-01-27. This notice does not itself change the stress test rule, but it signals a proposed paperwork collection revision tied to Dodd-Frank stress testing requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act notice announcing a closed Board meeting held on November 25, 2025, with less than seven days’ notice. It describes the meeting status, timing, location, and that the Board considered resolution, supervision, and corporate matters.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of Change in Bank Control Act applications for two proposed acquisitions of bank holding company shares. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-12-15. This is a public notice of pending ownership-change applications, not a rule change or decision.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act filings for proposed acquisitions/retentions of voting shares in a bank holding company and bank. Interested persons may comment by 2025-12-09. This is a public notice of an authorisation/perimeter matter, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on two bank holding company applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. It lists the applicants, the targets to be acquired, and sets a comment deadline of 2025-12-24. This is an application/perimeter notice, not a rule change.

title: Request for Information: Streamlining the Call Report
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC are seeking comments on ways to streamline the Call Report forms and instructions for institutions that file FFIEC 031, 041 or 051. This is a consultation only, with comments due by 2026-01-30. Banks that file the Call Report should review the proposal and assess reporting burden and data impacts.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC issued a notice that it has sent an information collection request for Rule 50.50 (end-user notification of non-cleared swaps) to OMB for review and public comment. It invites comments by 2026-01-05 but does not itself change the rule or create new obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company merger application by FirstSun Capital Bancorp to merge with First Foundation, Inc. Comments on the application must be received by 2026-01-05. This is an applications-and-notice process, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Guidance on Sound Incentive Compensation Policies
summary: The OCC is seeking comment on renewal of the Paperwork Reduction Act clearance for its information collection tied to Guidance on Sound Incentive Compensation Policies. Comments are due by 2026-02-02. The notice does not change the underlying guidance or create new requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List on 2025-12-03 under U.S. sanctions authorities. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with the designated parties. Firms should screen immediately and apply blocking and escalation controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13382, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the action date noted by OFAC and requires immediate sanctions screening and controls updates for any in-scope activity.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control application under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2025-12-23 on the proposed acquisition/retention of voting shares in the named bank holding company and bank. This is a notice and comment invitation, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving notice of pending applications by bank holding companies to merge with or acquire banks or bank holding companies. Interested persons may comment by 2026-01-07. This is a notice of proposed change in control/formation, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is seeking comment, under the Paperwork Reduction Act, on reinstating OMB approval for the existing Mortgage Acts and Practices—Advertising (Regulation N) information collection. Comments are due by 2026-02-09. The notice does not itself change the rule, but it concerns recordkeeping tied to mortgage advertising requirements.

title: Federal Reserve Bank Services
summary: The Federal Reserve approved 2026 fee schedules for priced services and electronic access, effective 2026-01-01. It also announced service changes including a new Payee Name Verification tool, sunsets for some products, and expanded eligibility for an ACH receipt discount program. This is a market/operational notice for users of Federal Reserve services, not a new rule for banks.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is seeking comment on reinstating OMB approval for an existing Regulation V information collection related to consumer disclosures and trafficking-related adverse information. Comments are due by 2026-02-09. This notice does not itself change substantive requirements.

title: Request for Information and Comment on the Future of the Federal Reserve Banks' Check Services
summary: The Federal Reserve is seeking comments on the future of Reserve Banks’ check services, including possible simplification, wind-down, or further investment. Banks and other check service users may be affected by any future changes in service and fees. Comments are due by 2026-03-09.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB is seeking comment on extending OMB approval for the existing Regulation DD / Truth in Savings information collection. Comments are due by 2026-02-09. The notice does not change substantive requirements; it only asks for feedback on burden, utility, clarity, and ways to reduce reporting burden.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of proposals by named companies to engage in or acquire permissible nonbanking activities under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2025-12-26. This is a notice of pending applications, not a rule or decision.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; U.S. Business Income Tax Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance
summary: The Treasury Department published a 30-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on IRS information collection for U.S. business income tax returns and related forms, schedules, attachments, and published guidance. Comments are due by 2026-01-14. This is a burden/renewal notice, not a new tax rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an information collection request on the costs of BSA/AML compliance for CFTC-registered futures commission merchants and introducing brokers has been sent to OMB for review. Comments are due by 2026-01-14. This is an information-gathering notice, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments on the applications by 2026-01-15. This is relevant to firms considering US bank holding company transactions or related ownership changes.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on proposed change-in-bank-control transactions involving a bank holding company and bank. Interested persons may comment by 2025-12-31.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Revenue Procedure 2026-6 and Form 15714
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-02-17 on an information collection request for Revenue Procedure 2026-6 and Form 15714 under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It concerns a new collection for State governments related to voluntary election to participate under IRC section 25F. No substantive rule change is made in this notice.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for persons seeking to retain or acquire voting shares of specified banks or bank holding companies. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-01-02. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a new rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Renew Collection 3038-0107, Generic Clearance for the Collection of Qualitative Feedback on Agency Service Delivery
summary: The CFTC is seeking public comment on renewing its existing PRA generic information collection for qualitative feedback on agency service delivery under OMB Control No. 3038-0107. Comments are due by 2026-02-17. This is a renewal request, not a new substantive rule, and it applies to respondents participating in CFTC consumer outreach and feedback activities.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing bank control change applications under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y, including one to join a family control group and indirectly retain voting shares in a Tennessee bank holding company and bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-01-02. No rule change is made; this is an application notice only.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Burden Related To Disclaiming an Interest in Property Received by Gift or Inheritance
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on an existing information collection for qualified disclaimers of property received by gift or inheritance. It says there is no change to the previously approved burden and asks for comments by 2026-02-17.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: NCUA is proposing changes to its Privacy Act system of records notice for the NCUA-19 Financial and Acquisition Management System. The notice adds and revises routine uses, updates storage and safeguards language, and aligns the format with OMB guidance. Comments are due by 2026-01-20; the modified system is effective immediately, with new routine uses effective on that date.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of bank holding company merger/acquisition applications, inviting public comments on the listed transaction under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Comments must be received by 2026-01-20. This concerns institutions seeking to become or acquire a bank holding company or bank.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Application To Participate in the Income Verification Express Service (IVES) Program (Form 13803)
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an extension of the existing IVES information collection (Form 13803) under the Paperwork Reduction Act. There is no change to the approved collection. Comments are due by 2026-02-17.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies; Correction
summary: The Federal Reserve issued a correction to a prior notice on bank holding company formations, acquisitions and mergers. It withdraws one specific Atlanta Fed notice relating to Anthem Financial Corporation. No new substantive requirement is created.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List and related sanctions lists by unblocking some persons, removing others, and correcting identifying information for designated persons. U.S. persons and firms with U.S. nexus should screen against the revised entries and remove any parties no longer listed. Effective immediately for sanctions screening and payments controls.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a bank control notice for a proposed acquisition of voting shares in Whitcorp Financial Company, which would indirectly affect Western State Bank and Frontier Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-01-06.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and vessels to the SDN List under Iran-related sanctions. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective on the action date stated in the notice (December 18, 2025).

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Fulton Financial Corporation has applied to merge with Blue Foundry Bancorp and indirectly acquire Blue Foundry Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-01-21. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or approval.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFPB proposes to modify its Privacy Act system of records for civil penalty fund and bureau-administered redress records. The change adds a new routine use for disclosures to Treasury, updates the purpose to prevent improper payments, and revises retention/disposal practices. Comments are due by 2026-01-21; the new system would take effect the same day unless the CFPB decides otherwise.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFPB proposes to modify its Privacy Act system of records for the Transit Subsidy Program, adding a new routine use for disclosures to Treasury and clarifying the records may be used to prevent improper payments. Comments are due by 2026-01-21; the revised system is set to become effective the same day unless comments change that outcome.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; OCC Supplier Registration Form
summary: The OCC is seeking comment on a revised OCC Supplier Registration Form under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The change updates the format of business classification information, but does not change the ability of suppliers to register. Comments are due by 2026-02-23.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Information Collection Requests
summary: Treasury published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking public comment on several IRS information collection requests before OMB review. It does not create new substantive tax obligations; comments are due by 2026-01-22. The requests cover magnetic-media returns, REMIC-related affidavits/information, and utility construction-aid reporting.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for proposed acquisitions/retentions of voting shares in specific US banks and bank holding companies. Interested persons may comment by 2026-01-07. This is a notice of applications and comment opportunity, not a new rule.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council on January 14, 2026, with an option to attend virtually. The notice invites public attendance and written statements, and lists discussion topics, but it does not create or change any requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Savings and Loan Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a notice of applications for savings and loan holding company formations, acquisitions, and mergers. Interested persons may submit comments on whether the proposed transaction complies with HOLA standards by 2026-01-28. This is a public notice, not a rule or approval.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice adding named persons to the SDN List. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms should screen immediately against the new names and apply blocking controls.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act filings for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-01-14. The notice is informational and does not itself approve or impose requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and entities to the SDN List and identified related vessels as blocked property. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and any property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective from the December 11, 2025 designation date.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List to add several persons and vessels linked to Venezuela sanctions, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective as of the December 31, 2025 designation date and requires immediate sanctions screening and payment/transaction controls.

title: Community Reinvestment Act Regulations Asset-Size Thresholds
summary: The FDIC and Federal Reserve announced updated 2026 CRA asset-size thresholds for defining small bank and intermediate small bank. The thresholds apply from 2026-01-07 through 2026-12-31 and affect which banks are subject to the related CRA performance standards. This is an annual inflation adjustment notice, not a new rulemaking.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application to acquire shares of a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Comments are due by 2026-01-22. This is a notice of a pending control-change filing, not a new rule or decision.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of pending Bank Holding Company Act applications for two firms seeking approval to become bank holding companies or acquire banks. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-02-09. This is a notice of applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment on TD 7918, Creditability of Foreign Taxes
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection under TD 7918 on the creditability of foreign taxes. There is no substantive rule change; comments are due by 2026-03-10.

title: Debt Management Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a closed Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee meeting on 3 February 2026 to discuss the economy, financial markets, Treasury financing and debt management, and to provide recommendations to the Secretary. It is a notice only and does not create new requirements for firms.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Savings and Loan Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications for formations, acquisitions, and mergers of savings and loan holding companies under HOLA, Regulation LL, and Regulation MM. It invites public comments on whether the proposed transaction meets statutory standards, with comments due by 2026-02-09. This is an authorisation/perimeter notice for affected holding companies and savings associations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment on Return of Excise Taxes Related to Employee Benefit Plans
summary: The IRS issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on the existing information collection for Form 5330 and Form 8868, used to report and pay excise taxes related to employee benefit plans. There is no change to the approved collection. Comments are due by 2026-03-13.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company merger applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-02-11 on the listed transaction, including Associated Banc-Corp’s proposed merger with American National Corporation and indirect acquisition of American National Bank.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving notice of a bank holding company merger application by Rhineland Bancshares, Inc. and inviting public comments by 2026-02-13. This is an application notice, not a rule change, and it concerns bank holding companies and related acquisitions in the US.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The IRS issued a notice establishing a new Privacy Act computer matching program to share tax return information with federal, state and local agencies for benefit eligibility and payment checks. Public comments are due within 30 days of Federal Register publication. If no comments are received, the re-established agreement is effective on 2026-01-15 and is expected to run through 2027-07-16.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for entries on the SDN List and SSI List to correct minor errors and improve standardization. This affects sanctions screening and list management for firms with U.S. sanctions exposure, effective from the stated January 8, 2026 update date.

title: Joint Report to Congressional Committees: Differences in Accounting and Capital Standards Among the Federal Banking Agencies as of September 30, 2025; Report to Congressional Committees
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC published their annual report to Congress on differences in accounting and capital standards as of 2025-09-30. The report says no material differences were identified for insured depository institutions. It is informational only and creates no new requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. This is effective from the action date of 2026-01-15.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added multiple Russian energy-sector entities to the SDN List, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2025-10-22 and published on 2026-01-21. Banks and other firms with sanctions exposure should update screening, blocks, and counterparty due diligence immediately.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on an application by Home BancShares to merge with Mountain Commerce Bancorp and indirectly acquire Mountain Commerce Bank. Comments are due by 2026-02-20. This is a notice of a pending bank holding company transaction, not a rule or supervisory requirement.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA announces an open Sunshine Act meeting on 2026-01-22 to discuss a Board briefing on Part 701 dependent care and board member expense reimbursement, and the Central Liquidity Facility’s 2026-2027 budget. This is a notice of a meeting agenda only; it does not itself change rules or impose deadlines.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The FDIC announces an open Board meeting for January 22, 2026, and lists items to be discussed, including amendments to appeal guidelines and a final rule on official signs and advertising. This notice is for information only and does not itself create obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen for the new names and any related ownership or control links effective from the action date, 2026-01-16.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company acquisition/merger applications and invited public comments. FirstBanc of Alabama, Inc. proposed merging with FBDC Financial Corp. and indirectly acquiring First Fidelity Bank. Comments are due by 2026-02-23.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act notice announcing a closed Board meeting on January 22, 2026, to consider resolution, supervision, and corporate activities. It is informational only and does not create any new requirements or deadlines.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List, adding one or more persons and removing at least one entity and related vessel, effective from 2026-01-21. U.S. persons must not deal with newly designated parties and must unblock/remove the delisted parties from sanctions screening and controls as applicable.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices for proposed acquisitions of voting shares in two US bank groups. Interested persons may submit written comments by 2026-02-10. The notice concerns applications under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for banks and bank holding companies in New York and Iowa.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications for formation, acquisition and merger approvals under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. It invites public comments by 2026-02-25 on the listed transaction involving Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. and LINKBANCORP, Inc.

title: Guidelines for Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
summary: The FDIC has adopted revised Guidelines for Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations, replacing the Supervision Appeals Review Committee with an independent Office of Supervisory Appeals to hear appeals from insured depository institutions. The revised process becomes effective once the Office is fully operational. IDIs should note the new appellate structure for challenging material supervisory determinations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Dividends and Distributions
summary: The IRS is asking for public comments on its existing Dividends and Distributions information collection for Form 1099-DIV under the Paperwork Reduction Act. There are no substantive changes to the collection, but the estimated number of responses has been updated. Comments are due by 2026-03-30.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation and acquisition applications. It invites public comments on two transactions by February 27, 2026, including Enova International’s proposed merger to become a bank holding company and PB Family Bancshares’ proposed acquisition of Gateway Bank.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Stress Testing Rules for National Banks and Federal Savings Associations
summary: The OCC is seeking comment and renewing OMB approval for its information collection on stress testing rules for national banks and federal savings associations. This is a PRA notice about paperwork burden, not a new rule. Comments are due by 2026-03-02.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company merger application: OceanFirst Financial Corp. seeks approval to merge with Flushing Financial Corporation and indirectly acquire Flushing Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-03-02. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Extensions of Credit to Insiders and Transactions With Affiliates
summary: The OCC published a notice seeking comment on renewal of its information collection on extensions of credit to insiders and transactions with affiliates, and sent the collection to OMB for review. Comments are due by 2026-03-04. This is a paperwork-reduction notice, not a change to the underlying insider/affiliate transaction rules.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for named individuals to retain or acquire voting shares of Touchmark Bancshares and indirectly Touchmark National Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-02-17. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on several IRS information collection requests, including withholding tax, debt instruments, timely filing, and golden parachute payment forms/rules. Comments are due by 2026-03-04. It does not itself change any tax obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Assessment of Fees
summary: The OCC is seeking comment on a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice to renew, without change, the “Assessment of Fees” information collection (OMB control 1557-0223). It affects businesses, including national banks, Federal savings associations and independent credit card institutions. Comments are due by 2026-04-06; the OCC will issue a second 30-day notice after this period.

title: Request for Information Related to the Financial Literacy and Education Commission (FLEC) Update to the U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy
summary: Treasury issued a request for information seeking public input on updates to the FLEC’s U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy. Comments are due by 2026-04-06. It asks for views on priority areas, best practices, fraud/scam prevention, and use of youth investment accounts such as Trump Accounts.

title: Proposed Collection; Request for Comments
summary: NCUA issued a notice seeking public comments on a new proposed information collection for Travel Management, submitted to OMB under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-03-05. The notice is informational and does not itself create new substantive requirements for credit unions.

title: Privacy Act; Systems of Records
summary: Treasury has proposed a new Privacy Act system of records for financial assistance programs it administers, including several federal grant and aid programmes. Comments are due by 2026-03-06, the system is effective on publication, and routine uses apply on 2026-03-06 unless Treasury revises the notice.

title: Establish New and Updated Prices for United States Mint Numismatic Products
summary: The U.S. Mint announced updated retail prices for a range of numismatic products, effective 2026-01-20. This affects customers and distribution/product operations for Mint coin and medal products, but does not create regulatory obligations for banks or financial firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for the acquisition of shares in Park Financial Group and indirectly Park State Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-02-23. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Retail Foreign Exchange Transactions
summary: The OCC issued a notice seeking comments by 2026-04-13 on renewal of its Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for retail foreign exchange transactions. It does not change the underlying rule, but reminds national banks and federal savings associations of existing reporting, disclosure and recordkeeping requirements under 12 CFR part 48.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists to improve data standardization and correct minor errors. This affects screening and sanctions operations immediately for any parties using OFAC lists. No new sanctions are imposed, but list data has been amended.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC has published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries already on its sanctions lists, to improve standardisation or correct minor errors. This affects screening and sanctions controls immediately on publication; no new sanctions target or deadline is created.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists, to standardize data and correct minor record errors. This affects parties screening against OFAC lists and is effective as reflected in the underlying 2025-09-23 update.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on Burden Related to Form 1120-ND, Return for Nuclear Decommissioning Funds and Certain Related Persons
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on the information collection burden for Form 1120-ND, used by nuclear decommissioning funds and certain related persons. No form changes are proposed; this is an extension of an existing approved collection. Comments are due by 2026-04-13.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists, mainly to improve standardization or correct minor errors. Firms should check screening and sanctions controls against the updated names and relevant authorities. No new sanctions program or separate compliance deadline is stated in the notice.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and vessels to the SDN List, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This takes effect immediately on the dates stated in the notice and is relevant for sanctions screening, customer/vessel onboarding, payments and asset freezes.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is notifying the public of bank holding company formation, acquisition and merger applications. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-03-16. This is a notice of pending applications, not a rule or approval, and it applies to the named US bank holding companies and related banks.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for the White Family Control Group to retain voting shares in Peoples Bancorp, Inc. and indirectly Peoples State Bank. Comments on the application are due by 2026-03-05. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Application for Extension of Time To File a Return and/or Pay U.S. Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Taxes
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments, by 2026-04-20, on an existing information collection for Form 4768, used to request extensions of time to file and/or pay U.S. estate and generation-skipping transfer taxes. The notice states there is no change to the collection and seeks feedback under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

title: Public Meeting of the Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee
summary: The United States Mint issued an amended notice for a Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee public meeting, adding review of a Semiquincentennial Gold Coin to the agenda and extending the public accommodation request deadline to 2026-02-20. This is a meeting notice, not a rule change, and it affects public participation rather than bank obligations.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC issued a notice modifying its Privacy Act system of records FDIC-035, renaming it and updating categories, routine uses, storage/retention, and access procedures for credentialing, facility access, and visitor management records. The notice is effective February 20, 2026, with comments due by March 23, 2026, and the routine uses taking effect March 23, 2026 unless changed after comments.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on TD 9035, Constructive Transfers and Transfers of Property to a Third Party on Behalf of a Spouse
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments by 2026-04-21 on an existing information collection under Treasury Regulation section 1.1041-2. It does not change the underlying tax rule and says there is no change to the previously approved collection.

title: Corporation To Do Business Under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act
summary: The FRB published a notice of an application under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act for GreatAmerica Holdings, Inc. to establish an Edge Corporation. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-10. This is a notice of a pending authorisation/perimeter matter, not a rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List by adding one person and removing one entity, effective from the stated January 30, 2026 determination dates. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with newly listed parties, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. Applies to firms with U.S. nexus or dealings in sanctioned persons.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists to improve standardization or correct minor errors. The change affects parties subject to U.S. sanctions screening and list-management processes and is already reflected as of 2026-02-19.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on proposed change-in-bank-control applications for shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-12. It affects entities involved in bank ownership/control transactions, rather than setting new rules.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Precious Metal Products
summary: The U.S. Mint announced updated 2026 pricing for numismatic gold, palladium and platinum products, including expanded pricing ranges and pricing for Best of the Mint products. Prices may change weekly based on the LBMA gold price average and are reviewed every Wednesday.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Nicaragua-related sanctions authorities. U.S. property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date of 2026-02-26.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice removing one or more persons from the SDN List and unblocking their property and interests in property, while also updating another SDN entry that remains blocked. This affects U.S.-jurisdiction sanctions screening and customer/transaction controls as of the stated February 27, 2026 actions.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment on Affordable Care Act Internal Claims and Appeals and External Review Disclosures
summary: The IRS issued a notice inviting public comment on a Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Affordable Care Act internal claims and appeals and external review disclosures. Comments are due by 2026-05-04. The notice describes burden estimate changes and existing disclosure requirements, but it does not itself create new obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on reinstating the information collection for Regulation P (Privacy of Consumer Financial Information). Comments are due by 2026-04-06. This is a solicitation for public comment on burden and utility, not a new rule or binding requirement.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added four individuals and one entity to the SDN List under E.O. 13413, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Effective March 2, 2026. Sanctions screening and payment/onboarding controls should be updated immediately.

title: Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee: Charter Renewal
summary: The IRS announced renewal of the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee’s charter under FACA. The committee will continue advising on electronic tax administration, including identity theft and refund fraud prevention. The charter will be filed no earlier than seven days after publication. No new obligations are imposed on firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the action date stated in the notice, so sanctions screening and interdiction controls should be updated immediately for any exposed customers, counterparties or payments.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC removed one person and one vessel from the SDN List and unblocked their property interests under U.S. jurisdiction, effective March 4, 2026. Sanctions screening and watchlist teams should update systems and cases accordingly; no filing deadline is stated.

title: Reestablishment of the Federal Advisory Committee on Insurance
summary: Treasury is reestablishing the Federal Advisory Committee on Insurance to advise the Federal Insurance Office on insurance-market issues. The committee’s charter will be filed with Congress at least seven days after publication, and future membership nominations will be sought in a later notice. This is informational and does not itself impose obligations on firms.

title: Amendment of Notice of Funds Availability for Community Development Financial Institutions Program; Revised Application Submission Deadline
summary: The CDFI Fund revised the application submission deadline for eligible applicants in the FY 2025 Community Development Financial Institutions Program. Applicants notified that they may update prior applications must now submit by 2026-04-10 at 11:59 p.m. ET. All other NOFA requirements remain unchanged.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisition of voting shares in Chesapeake Financial Shares, Inc. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-03-25. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisition of shares in Genesis Bancorp, Inc. and Genesis Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-26. This is a public notice and comment opportunity, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of pending Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquisitions of shares in named banks or bank holding companies. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-30. This is an informational notice about proposed control changes, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee on March 25, 2026, and invited public attendance and written statements by March 23, 2026. It is a meeting notice only; it does not change any requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing a bank holding company merger application and inviting public comments by 2026-04-16. It does not itself approve the transaction or impose new requirements; it simply announces the filing and comment process for interested persons.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Average Area Purchase Price Safe Harbors and Nationwide Purchase Prices Under Section 143
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act for average area purchase price safe harbors and nationwide purchase prices under section 143. It is an extension of an existing collection with no changes to the revenue procedure. Comments are due by 2026-05-18.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving public notice of a bank holding company acquisition application under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-17 on the listed transaction involving A.N.B. Holding Company and The ANB Corporation/American National Bank of Texas.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment on Application for Central Withholding Agreement; Directed Withholding and Deposit Verification; IRS Secure Messaging Taxpayer Agreement and Disclosure Authorization to Designated Users
summary: The IRS is requesting public comment on a revised information collection covering Central Withholding Agreement applications, withholding/deposit verification, and secure messaging authorizations. Comments are due by 2026-05-18. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a new rule, and it updates forms and burden estimates rather than imposing new substantive requirements.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company nonbanking proposals under Regulation Y and the Bank Holding Company Act. Interested persons may comment on the listed application until 2026-04-20. The notice concerns Columbia Financial’s proposed acquisition of Northfield Bancorp and indirect acquisition of Northfield Bank, and is relevant to U.S. bank holding companies and their permissible activities.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company application activity and invited public comments by 2026-04-20 on Columbia Bank MHC’s proposed mutual-to-stock conversion and related acquisition/formation steps. It is a notice of applications, not a rule or decision, and does not itself change requirements.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Numismatic Products
summary: The U.S. Mint published a notice setting retail prices for two 2026 numismatic products: a 2-roll set at $40 and a 200-coin bag at $54. It is informational only and does not impose compliance obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company application: Bank of Nova Scotia seeks approval to acquire up to 19.99% of KeyCorp and indirectly KeyBank National Association. Comments must be submitted by 2026-04-20.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Contract Solicitation and Post-Award Information Requirements
summary: Treasury issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking public comment on two existing contractor information collections related to post-award reporting and proposal submissions for Treasury procurement. It does not change obligations yet; comments are due by 2026-05-19.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings; Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a Board meeting held on March 19, 2026. The notice records that the Board discussed proposed capital rulemaking and approved a final rule on deposit insurance coverage for certain U.S. bank branches, plus a rescission of a policy statement, but the notice itself imposes no requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is inviting public comments on an application by Rhinebeck Bancorp MHC to convert from mutual to stock form and merge with its subsidiary as part of a bank holding company transaction. Comments are due by 2026-04-22. This is a notice of application and comment period, not a rule or approval.

title: Recission of the Statement of Policy on Qualifications for Failed Bank Acquisitions
primary_functions: Regulatory change; Compliance; Financial crime; Legal
summary: The FDIC rescinds its 2009 Statement of Policy on Qualifications for Failed Bank Acquisitions and related 2010 Q&As, effective 2026-03-23. Private capital investors and other nonbank acquirers of failed insured depository institutions remain subject to existing laws and regulations, including capital, control, affiliate transaction and AML/CFT requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisition/retention of shares in a bank holding company and its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-09. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Electronic Payee Statements
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an extension of its Paperwork Reduction Act approval for electronic payee statements under existing final regulations. It covers voluntary electronic furnishing of Forms W-2, 1098-T and 1098-E for businesses and educational institutions. Comments are due by 2026-05-26. No regulatory requirements are changed.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice inviting comments on a bank holding company application: Longhorn Medical Holdings, Inc. seeks approval to become a bank holding company by acquiring Robert Lee Bancshares, Inc. and indirectly Robert Lee State Bank. Comments are due by 2026-04-24.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for certain parties seeking to join a control group and retain or acquire voting shares of a bank holding company and its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-10.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on Burden Related to Information Authorization and IRS Disclosure Authorization for Victims of Identity Theft
summary: The IRS issued a notice requesting public comments on the burden of an existing information collection for Forms 8821 and 8821-A, used for tax information authorization and disclosure authorization in identity-theft cases. It is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice only, with no form changes at this time. Comments are due by 2026-05-26.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC are seeking comment on extending, with revision, information collections tied to proposed regulatory capital rules for large and trading-active banking organizations. Comments are due by 2026-05-26. This is a consultation notice only; it does not itself change capital requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company application under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. It concerns North Salem State Bancorporation’s proposed acquisition of voting shares in Tri-County Bancorp. Comments must be submitted by 2026-04-29.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on reinstating an information collection for Regulation V’s human-trafficking-related adverse-information prohibition. Comments are due by 2026-04-29. This notice does not itself change substantive requirements; it is an information-collection request affecting private-sector respondents.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receivership
summary: FDIC notice that the receivership for Citizens National Bank, Macomb, Illinois will be terminated no sooner than 30 days after the notice date. Interested parties may submit written comments within 30 days; the notice also says a final dividend to proven creditors will be made if funds permit.

title: Interest Rate Paid on Cash Deposited To Secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Immigration Bonds
summary: Treasury published the quarterly interest rate for cash deposited to secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement immigration bonds: 3% per annum for April 1, 2026 through June 30, 2026. This is an informational market/operational notice for affected bond cash holders; no new compliance obligation is created beyond applying the stated rate during the period.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published updates to the SDN List, including identifying-information changes and multiple removals/unblockings effective on the stated March 2026 dates. Firms dealing with U.S.-jurisdiction property or sanctions screening must update watchlists and records promptly; no new compliance deadline is stated in the notice itself.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: NCUA announced an open Sunshine Act Board meeting on April 9, 2026, to discuss brokered and reciprocal deposits, deregulation, and its 2026-2030 strategic and annual performance plans. This is a meeting notice only and does not itself create requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on applications for bank holding company formations, acquisitions and mergers, including Santander’s proposed acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-07. The notice is for public comment and review of applications, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications by several firms to become bank holding companies or acquire banks, and invited public comments by 2026-05-08. This is a notice of pending perimeter/authorisation changes, not a rule or approval decision.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for an open Board meeting held on 7 April 2026 with less than seven days’ notice. The notice lists agenda items including proposed rules on payment stablecoin issuers, AML/CFT programs, and a final rule prohibiting use of reputation risk by regulators, but the notice itself creates no obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application for Fulda Bancorporation, Inc. to acquire Root River State Bank. Interested persons may comment on the application by 2026-05-11.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application for certain persons to join a control group and retain voting shares of a bank holding company and bank. Comments are due by 2026-04-27. This affects banks and bank holding companies involved in ownership/control changes.

title: Designation of Databases to the Do Not Pay Working System
summary: Treasury has designated SSA’s Numident database for use in the Do Not Pay Working System, effective immediately. Federal and federally funded state-administered health or income maintenance programs may use it to verify names, Social Security numbers and dates of birth to help prevent improper payments. Agencies using the system are reminded to follow privacy, security and verification safeguards.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve is seeking comment on extending, with revision, its information collection for the Survey of Small Business and Farm Lending (FR 2028) for sampled banks. Comments are due by 2026-06-09. This is a proposed reporting/information collection change, not a final rule.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage In or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of company proposals to engage in, or acquire companies engaged in, permissible nonbanking activities under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-27. This affects proposed US bank holding company activities, including extending credit and servicing loans.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Gas Guzzler Tax
summary: The IRS is seeking comments by 2026-06-15 on an existing information collection for the gas guzzler tax (Form 6197/Form 720). The notice says there is no change to the approved collection and simply extends it under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Retail Foreign Exchange Transactions
summary: The OCC requests comments on renewal of the Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for retail foreign exchange transactions and has sent it to OMB for review. National banks and federal savings associations already subject to the retail forex rule are mentioned as the affected public. Comments are due by 2026-05-20.

title: Reestablishment of the Art Advisory Panel of the Commissioner of Internal Revenue
summary: The IRS reestablishes the Art Advisory Panel for two years, starting no sooner than seven days after publication. The panel will help evaluate art appraisals for federal income, estate, and gift tax purposes, and its meetings will be closed to protect tax return confidentiality.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and related bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-06. This is a public notice of pending ownership control applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and entities to the SDN List under Nicaragua sanctions. U.S. persons must not deal with them, and all property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked, effective from the April 16, 2026 action date.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of its Advisory Council on May 6, 2026, to discuss possible future recommendations on IRS operations, taxpayer service, compliance, tax administration, information reporting, and tax-exempt/government entities. Public registration and any written statement are due by May 4, 2026. This is an informational notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application: GEBSCO, Inc. seeks approval to acquire Rushford State Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-22. This is an application notice, not a rule, and it does not itself create obligations for firms, other than the public comment deadline for the specific filing.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC is modifying its Privacy Act system of records notice for FDIC-012, Financial Information Management Records, including updated routine uses, record categories, retention, access, and notification procedures. The notice is effective April 23, 2026, with proposed routine uses effective May 26, 2026 unless changed after comments. Comments are due by May 26, 2026. This mainly affects privacy governance and legal review rather than bank obligations.

title: Application and Renewal Fees Imposed on Surety Companies and Reinsuring Companies; Increase in Fees Imposed
summary: The US Treasury’s Bureau of the Fiscal Service increased the fees charged to surety companies and reinsuring companies for applications and annual renewals of authority/certification, effective January 1, 2026. Firms seeking or renewing Treasury recognition as surety or reinsurer should use the new fee schedule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company application activity. It invites public comments by 2026-05-25 on Green Mountain Mutual Bancorp’s proposal to become a bank holding company by acquiring Brattleboro Savings and Loan Association. No rule changes are made; this is an application/perimeter notice affecting the named firm and potentially similar applicants.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Request for Nominations
summary: The IRS is seeking nominations and applications for volunteer members of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council. Applications are due by 2026-06-05, and appointments begin in January 2027. The notice describes eligibility, required statements, and clearance checks, but does not create new requirements for regulated firms.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company application activity: Independent Bank Corporation seeks approval to merge with HCB Financial Corp and indirectly acquire Highpoint Community Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-27.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for a group acting in concert to retain voting shares of First Illinois Corporation and indirectly its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-12. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-04-23 and published on 2026-04-27. Firms must screen and implement any required blocking or payment interdiction immediately.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of pending applications for bank holding company formations, acquisitions and mergers under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. It invites public comments by 2026-05-28 on the listed transactions, including several cross-border structures involving Chilean groups and U.S. bank interests.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comment on a bank holding company proposal to acquire a company engaged in permissible nonbanking activity under Regulation Y. Comments are due by 2026-05-13. This is a notice of application, not a rule change, and it applies to the named proposal in the United States.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control application for the Schultz Family Control Group to acquire voting shares of Luana Bancorporation and indirectly Luana Savings Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-13. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or supervisory requirement.

title: Order Preempting the Illinois Interchange Fee Prohibition Act
summary: The OCC has issued an interim final order finding that federal law preempts the Illinois Interchange Fee Prohibition Act as applied to national banks and federal savings associations. It takes effect on 2026-06-30 and invites comments by 2026-05-29. Banks using payment cards in Illinois should assess fee, data-use, and merchant contract impacts.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
