summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquisitions of shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may submit written comments by 2026-05-18. This affects bank control transactions and the related public comment process for the named applicants and target institutions.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added a named individual to the SDN List, blocking any property or interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Effective from the April 30, 2026 action date; firms should screen and freeze any relevant exposure immediately.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC published notice that it has terminated the receivership of Silver Falls Bank, effective 2026-05-01. The receivership has been discharged and ceased to exist as a legal entity.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed retention of voting shares in Quaint Oak Bancorp and Quaint Oak Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-21. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receiverships
summary: The FDIC gives notice that it intends to terminate the receiverships of America West Bank and Washington Federal Bank for Savings after liquidation is complete. Any comments must be submitted in writing within 30 days of the notice date; the termination becomes effective no sooner than 30 days after publication.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public notice list of institutions for which it has been appointed receiver. This is an information notice for the failed bank named in the list, effective as of the stated date closed, and supports reliance as record notice rather than imposing new requirements on firms.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications and invited public comments by 2026-06-08. It concerns Carpenter Bank Holdings LLC’s proposed acquisition of Security State Bank in Texas. This is informational only and does not itself approve or impose requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. This is an immediate sanctions-screening and controls update for firms with U.S. nexus or exposure.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under Iran sanctions authorities, blocking any property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This takes effect from the April 24, 2026 designation date and is relevant immediately for screening, blocking, and transaction controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 13902, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the issuance date, 2026-05-01.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: Treasury’s Fiscal Service proposes to modify its Privacy Act system of records for U.S. securities and access, adding a new routine use to share certain savings bond information with states to help locate owners or beneficiaries. Comments are due by 2026-06-10, and the new routine use would apply from that date.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications for formation, acquisitions and mergers. Interested persons may comment on the applications by 2026-06-11. This is a notice of pending authorisation activity for named US bank holding companies, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Opportunity Zones Nomination Tool
summary: Treasury is seeking public comment on reinstating an information collection tool used by states to nominate census tracts for Qualified Opportunity Zone designation. Comments are due by 2026-06-11. The notice reflects the new statutory nomination timetable under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, but it does not itself impose operating requirements on banks.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving public notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for Kenneth R. Lehman’s proposed acquisition of voting shares in BayFirst Financial Corp. and indirectly BayFirst National Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-27. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for certain individuals to acquire or retain voting shares of named bank holding companies and indirectly their banks. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-28. This is a notice and solicitation of public comments, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for requests for interpretative, no-action and exemptive letters has been sent to OMB for review and public comment. Comments are due by 2026-06-15. The notice describes the collection and burden only; it does not itself change rules or obligations.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for persons seeking to acquire shares of a bank or bank holding company, with comments due by 2026-06-01. It concerns proposed ownership changes for specific Kansas and Colorado parties and institutions. This is a notice and comment invitation, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added or revised one or more persons on the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, so sanctions screening and controls should be updated immediately. The notice reflects actions issued on 2026-05-08 and 2026-05-11.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The Treasury published notice of a new Privacy Act computer matching program using the Do Not Pay system to check Treasury benefits-program records for improper payments and eligibility. Comments are due by 2026-06-17, and the program becomes effective 30 days after publication and runs through 2029-09-10. This is a notice, not a rule, and is mainly informational for affected US Treasury benefit programs.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a proposed bank holding company nonbanking activity proposal under section 4 of the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Comments are due by 2026-06-02. The notice concerns Bayerische Raiffeisen-Beteiligungs-Aktiengesellschaft’s proposal to retain voting shares of BayWa AG and indirectly engage in permissible nonbanking activities in the United States.

title: Uniform Financial Institutions Rating System
summary: The FFIEC is seeking comment on proposed revisions to the Uniform Financial Institutions Rating System (CAMELS). The proposal would refocus ratings on factors that materially affect safety and soundness and improve transparency. Comments are due by 2026-08-17. It applies to federally examined financial institutions, including banks and credit unions.

title: List of Countries Requiring Cooperation With an International Boycott
summary: The U.S. Treasury published an updated list of countries that require or may require participation in, or cooperation with, an international boycott for Internal Revenue Code purposes. The listed countries are Iraq, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Syria and Yemen. This is a current sanctions/tax-related watchlist item for U.S.-linked activity; no action date is stated.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comment on renewing and revising an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for acquisition services. The collection covers contractor, vendor, prize competition and innovation pilot program forms used to do business with the FDIC, with comments due by 2026-06-22. The notice also says some form language will be removed and a new contractor nondiscrimination clause will be added for new contracts.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Margin and Capital Requirements for Covered Swap Entities
summary: The OCC issued a notice asking for comments on renewal of an OMB-approved information collection for its margin and capital requirements for covered swap entities. Comments are due by 2026-06-22. This is a paperwork-burden notice only; it does not itself change the underlying swap entity requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of pending Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquisitions or retained control of shares in named bank holding companies and banks. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-06-05. This is a notice and comment request, not a new rule, and applies to the named U.S. banks and bank holding companies.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under Iran-related sanctions authorities. U.S. property and interests in property of the listed parties are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Effective from the action date of 2026-05-19.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and removed one or more persons from it, effective May 21, 2026. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with the newly designated parties, and any U.S.-jurisdiction property or interests in property are blocked. Sanctions screening and payments controls should be updated immediately.

title: Proposed Revisions to the Federal Reserve Policy on Payment System Risk and the Guidelines for Account and Services Requests
summary: The Federal Reserve is consulting on revisions to its payment system risk policy and account access guidelines to support new special-purpose Payment Accounts at Reserve Banks, and to add timing expectations for certain account requests. Comments are due by 2026-07-27. The proposal affects institutions seeking Reserve Bank accounts and services, especially those under the Account Access Guidelines.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Augustus International Inc. has applied to become a bank holding company by acquiring Augustus National Bank, N.A. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-06-26. This is a public notice of a pending authorisation/change in control application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Credit for Renewable Electricity Production and Publication of Inflation Adjustment Factor and Reference Price for Calendar Year 2026
summary: The IRS published the 2026 inflation adjustment factor and reference price used to determine the section 45 renewable electricity production tax credit for 2026 sales. It confirms the wind and other listed resource phaseout does not apply for calendar year 2026 and explains related Inflation Reduction Act changes. No new compliance action or deadline is created by the notice itself.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition application by Peoples Bancorp Inc. to acquire Citizens National Corporation and indirectly Citizens Bank of Kentucky. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-01. This is a notice of applications and comment opportunity, not a rule or supervisory requirement.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice removing one or more persons from the SDN List and unblocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. Firms should check sanctions screening and customer/transaction monitoring against the updated list immediately.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comment on a bank holding company application under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit views by 2026-07-03 on a proposed acquisition of additional voting shares in a Mississippi bank holding company and its bank subsidiary.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the action date of 2026-05-29 and requires immediate sanctions screening and payment/transaction controls for any U.S.-touching business.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Application for Extension of Time To File Information Returns
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for Form 8809, used to request extensions of time to file certain information returns. There is no change to the collection itself. Comments are due by 2026-08-03.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve issued a correction to a prior notice about Mascoma Mutual Financial Services Corporation’s proposed merger with Androscoggin Bancorp, MHC, and related acquisition of Portland Trust Company, LLC. The corrected notice restates the transaction and trust company activity under Regulation Y. It is an informational correction only and does not impose a new deadline or requirement.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications and proposed acquisitions/mergers under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-06. This is relevant to firms considering US bank holding company formations or acquisitions, including the named applicants.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on IRS E-File Provider Participation and Compliance Collections
summary: The IRS published a notice seeking public comments on its Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for IRS e-file provider participation and compliance requirements. It does not change the underlying requirements; it only renews OMB approval and makes an administrative clarification. Comments are due by 2026-08-07.

title: Statement on Ability To Repay and Immigration Status
summary: The CFPB issued a statement reminding creditors that, under TILA/Regulation Z, ability-to-repay assessments may need to consider a consumer’s immigration status where it affects expected income or repayment. It is effective June 8, 2026 and applies to creditors making mortgage and certain open-end credit decisions.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for a group seeking to retain voting shares of a named Ohio state bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-06-24. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or order.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company proposal to acquire North Shore Trust and Savings and thereby engage in an activity permitted under Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-09. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Request Approval for Collection 3038-0117, Exemption From Derivatives Clearing Organization Registration
summary: The CFTC published a notice seeking public comment on its intent to request OMB approval to extend an existing information collection for exemptions from derivatives clearing organization registration. Comments are due by 2026-08-10. This is a PRA notice only; it does not itself change the underlying exemption rules or create new requirements.

title: Pricing for the FIFA World Cup 2026 TM Commemorative Coin Program and the 2026 Precious Metals Grid
summary: The U.S. Mint published a notice setting introductory and regular prices for FIFA World Cup 2026 commemorative coins and referring gold/platinum products to an existing pricing grid. It is informational and does not impose compliance obligations on financial firms.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Methyl Methacrylate-ethyl Methacrylate-methacrylic Acid Copolymer in a Styrene Solution (x=75.76, y=8.46, z=1, s=168.4); Hearing Cancellation
summary: The IRS announces it is cancelling a public hearing on a notice of filing about adding a chemical substance to the Superfund taxable substances list. The hearing scheduled for 2026-06-18 is cancelled because no one requested to testify. No new obligations are created by this notice.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection for registration under the Commodity Exchange Act has been sent to OMB for 30-day review and public comment. It concerns registration forms for swap dealers and major swap participants and related cross-border comparability and fingerprint-card processes. Comments are due by 2026-07-13.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Effective on issuance; the notice was issued on 2026-06-10.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of a bank holding company application for Fidelity Ban Corporation to acquire Welcome State Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-13. This is a notice of a pending authorisation/perimeter matter, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for a proposed acquisition of shares in a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-06-30. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a rule or decision.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receiverships
summary: The FDIC gives notice that it intends to terminate receiverships for four failed banks after liquidation is complete. Interested parties may submit written comments within 30 days of the notice date; the termination becomes effective no sooner than 30 days after the notice. This affects the named receiverships in the United States.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a bank control notice for proposed share acquisitions involving Capital Bancshares, Inc. and Savings Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-01. This is a notice of an application under the Change in Bank Control Act, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Fraud.gov Federal Program Waste, Fraud, and Abuse Tip Intake and Referral System
summary: Treasury is seeking public comments on a proposed new Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Fraud.gov’s tip intake and referral form. It would collect allegations of waste, fraud, abuse and related misconduct for routing to federal agencies. Comments are due by 2026-08-17.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage In or To Acquire Companies Engaged In Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of proposals from bank holding companies to engage in, or acquire companies engaged in, permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-03. The notice covers proposed bullion buying and selling activity for Frontier Community Bancshares, Inc. and other listed proposals.

title: OCC Policy Statement on Minority Depository Institutions
summary: The OCC revised its policy statement on Minority Depository Institutions to align more closely with FIRREA and remove obsolete material. The update keeps current MDI designations in place and describes how the OCC will maintain those designations going forward. It applies to national banks and federal savings associations. No separate compliance deadline is stated; the statement is effective as issued on 2026-06-16.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications for public comment. Interested persons may submit views by 2026-07-22 on the listed proposals to become bank holding companies and acquire banks. This is a notice of applications, not a rule or decision.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on Change in Bank Control Act applications for groups seeking to retain voting shares of Hometown Community Bancorp and Morton Community Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-08. This is a notice of pending ownership-control applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve has published notices of proposed changes in bank control for two US bank-related groups, inviting public comments by 2026-07-09. The notices describe applications to acquire voting shares of specified bank holding companies and indirectly their banks.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comments on renewal of two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act: bank services notifications for insured state nonmember banks and state savings associations, and disclosure/recordkeeping requirements for certain securitization and participation transactions by insured depository institutions. Comments are due by 2026-07-24. No substantive rule change is announced.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date of 2026-06-18.

title: Debt Management Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a closed meeting of the Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee on August 4, 2026 to discuss the economy, financial markets, Treasury financing and debt management. It is an advisory notice only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Certifications for Exceptions to the 10% Additional Tax
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for certifications supporting exceptions to the 10% additional tax on certain retirement plan distributions. The notice adds collection requirements from IRS Notice 2026-33 and asks for comments by 2026-08-24. It does not itself change substantive tax rules.

title: Designation of OpenCorporates Dataset Into DNP Working System
summary: Treasury is proposing to add OpenCorporates’ U.S. legal entity dataset to the Do Not Pay Working System. Comments are due by 2026-07-10. If finalized, federal agencies and federally funded state programs could use the dataset to verify entity status and help prevent improper payments and fraud.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and its subsidiary bank under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-13. This is a notice of filings and comment opportunity, not a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application: BancFirst Corporation seeks approval to acquire Spirit Bankcorp, Inc. and indirectly SpiritBank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of an application, not an approval or rule change.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting To Be Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice announcing a Board meeting and listing proposed rulemakings to be considered, including resolution submissions for covered insured depository institutions, assessment thresholds and rate schedules, and disclosure of information. This is a notice of meeting only; it does not itself change requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List and updating the identifying details of one listed person. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. Effective date of the action was June 23, 2026.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee
summary: The IRS is holding a public virtual meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee on July 15, 2026, and inviting comments and suggestions on improving IRS customer service. Registration is required by July 10, 2026. This is an informational notice only and does not impose obligations on firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications to acquire shares of specific banks and bank holding companies, and invited public comments by 2026-07-14. This is a notice about pending ownership-control filings, not a rule change. It is relevant to acquisition/control due diligence for affected banking groups.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: The FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a Board meeting held on June 25, 2026, open to public observation via webcast. The notice lists proposed rulemakings discussed, including resolution submissions for covered insured depository institutions, assessment thresholds and rate schedules, and disclosure of information. It is informational only and creates no direct obligations.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The FDIC announced a closed Board meeting under the Government in the Sunshine Act to consider resolution, supervision and corporate matters. It is an informational notice only and does not create requirements for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms with U.S. nexus must screen and update sanctions controls immediately. The action was issued on 2026-05-19 and published on 2026-06-29.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-06-22 and is immediately relevant for sanctions screening and blocking controls.

title: Funding Opportunities: Small Dollar Loan Program: FY 2026 Funding Round
summary: Treasury’s CDFI Fund issued a notice inviting applications for FY 2026 Small Dollar Loan Program grants. Eligible certified CDFIs may apply for loan loss reserve and technical assistance awards by 2026-07-30, with several earlier system and registration deadlines in late July 2026. This is a funding opportunity notice, not a rulemaking.

title: Funding Opportunities: Bank Enterprise Award Program (BEA) Program: FY 2026 Funding Round
summary: The U.S. Treasury CDFI Fund issued a FY 2026 Notice of Funds Availability for the Bank Enterprise Award Program, inviting applications from FDIC-insured banks and thrifts. It sets application steps and deadlines in July 2026, and describes award ranges and eligibility conditions for the grant program.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury Department is requesting public comments and OMB review for several IRS information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act, including forms and recordkeeping relating to tax reporting, electronic records, housing credits, REMICs, and tip reporting. Comments are due by 2026-07-30. This is a notice of proposed information collection, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Offering of U.S. Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Company Tax and Loss Bonds
summary: Treasury is seeking public comments on extending an existing information collection for U.S. Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Company Tax and Loss Bonds before OMB review. Comments are due by 2026-07-30. The notice does not itself change any requirements; it only solicits input on an existing collection.

title: Funding Opportunities: Bond Guarantee Program, FY 2026; Notice of Guarantee Availability
summary: The U.S. Treasury CDFI Fund announced FY 2026 availability of up to $500 million of Bond Guarantee authority and invited Qualified Issuer and Guarantee Applications. Applications open on publication, with deadlines of 2026-07-07 for Qualified Issuer Applications, 2026-07-08 for Guarantee Applications, and 2026-07-02 for any CDFI Certification Application. It is an application notice, not a rule change.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council on July 15, 2026. The meeting will discuss potential future recommendations on IRS operations, taxpayer service, compliance, tax administration, information reporting, and tax-exempt/government entities. Public attendees should register by July 13, 2026, and written statements for the Council are due by July 13, 2026.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Tax-Exempt Organization Complaint (Referral)
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for Form 13909, Tax-Exempt Organization Complaint (Referral). There are no form changes affecting burden; comments are due by 2026-08-28. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of proposed change-in-bank-control filings for several Texas bank and bank holding company acquisitions. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-16. This is an informational notice of applications, not a new rule or approval.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated and removed certain names and property entries on the SDN List, including a vessel removal and changes to identifying information for listed persons. U.S. persons and firms dealing with blocked property or screening/ sanctions controls should reflect the changes immediately. No separate filing deadline is given.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals to the SDN List under Executive Order 14098 for Sudan-related sanctions. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and any U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked, effective from the action date of 2026-06-26.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions targets immediately and ensure any existing exposure is identified and blocked.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Statement of Payments Received
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-08-31 on an unchanged extension of the Form 4669 information collection used to request relief from certain withholding taxes. It is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a new rule, and applies to payors who use the form.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Relief for Certain Spouses of Military Personnel
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an extension of an existing information collection for relief claims by certain spouses of military personnel under MSRRA. There is no change to the approved collection, and comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comment on renewal of two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act: reverse mortgage products and insurance sales consumer protections. The notice does not change the underlying substantive requirements; comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. Firms should screen immediately against the updated list and apply any required blocking or escalation procedures.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under E.O. 13902, blocking U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the June 5, 2026 action date and is relevant immediately for sanctions screening, payments, onboarding and exposure controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one person to the SDN List, blocking any property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This takes effect from the action date of 2026-05-27, with publication on 2026-07-02. Sanctions screening and payment controls should be updated immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists to correct or standardize records. The change affects parties subject to OFAC sanctions screening and watchlist maintenance, effective from the underlying update date of 2026-06-25.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment Tax Information Security Guidelines for Federal, State, and Local Agencies
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection under Paperwork Reduction Act procedures for Publication 1075, which concerns safeguards for federal tax information held by government agencies and their contractors. No substantive rule change is proposed; comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 147A(f)(1)(iii) Written Representation as to Purchaser Residency
summary: The SEC published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking OMB review and public comments on extending the existing information collection under Rule 147A(f)(1)(iii), which requires issuers relying on the intrastate offering exemption to obtain written purchaser residency representations. Comments are due by 2026-08-03. This is an administrative notice, not a rule change.

title: Request for Comment on Novel ETFs
summary: The SEC is seeking public comment on ETFs that invest in innovative asset classes or use novel strategies. It asks funds, advisers, investors and other market participants whether further action is needed to protect investors and support orderly markets. Comments are due within 60 days after Federal Register publication on 2026-07-02.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Amend the Redemptions Service Guide and the Operational Arrangements (Necessary for Securities To Become and Remain Eligible for DTC Services)
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a DTC proposed rule change that would update the Redemptions Service Guide and Operational Arrangements for payment without presentation. It would remove certain physical document requirements, make automated notifications part of the process, and impose retention/destruction protocols for eligible redemption and maturity events affecting DTC participants and agents.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Short Term Option Series Program Related to Qualifying Securities
summary: Nasdaq ISE has filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to expand and rename categories of short-term option series for certain exchange-traded funds, including new Tuesday/Thursday expirations for some products and new Monday/Wednesday expirations for others. The SEC is seeking public comments; no compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.31. Orders and Modifiers
summary: The NYSE proposes changes to Rule 7.31 so routable Limit Orders would operate as Inside Limit Orders, and all Discretionary Orders would be non-routable. The SEC is publishing the notice and seeking comments; this is relevant to trading and market-structure teams, with no immediate binding change unless the proposal is later approved.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend Rule 7.31E, Orders and Modifiers
summary: NYSE American proposed amending Rule 7.31E so routable Limit Orders would function as Inside Limit Orders by default, routing price by price to away markets unless otherwise specified. The SEC notice solicits comments on the proposal; no binding change is yet in effect. Market participants using NYSE American order types should assess the operational and trading impact.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-21 on a proposed acquisition/retention of voting shares involving Sterling City Bancshares and The First National Bank of Sterling City.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 14059 and E.O. 13224, blocking their property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen for these names and stop any prohibited activity immediately. The notice was issued on 2026-06-30 and published on 2026-07-06.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Certificate of Identity
summary: The Treasury’s Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on an extension of the approved Certificate of Identity information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. The notice concerns a form used by individuals claiming U.S. savings and retirement securities.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: TreasuryDirect System
summary: Treasury published a notice seeking comments on extending the approved TreasuryDirect System information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. The notice concerns account-opening and transaction-processing data collection for individuals and households, not a new substantive rule.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Special Form of Request for Payment of US Savings and Retirement Securities Where Use of a Detached Request Is Authorized
summary: The Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on extending an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form FS 1522, used to request payment of U.S. savings and retirement securities. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. This is a notice only and does not itself change any filing or payment requirements.

title: Manulife Investment Management Private Markets (US) LLC; Manulife Employee Securities Company 2025, L.P.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief for Manulife Investment Management Private Markets (US) LLC and Manulife Employee Securities Company 2025, L.P. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: NYSE Arca filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to increase certain manual options fees for market makers in non-Penny issues and add a $0.20 rebate for floor broker orders trading with market maker orders. It is open for SEC comment, and the fee schedule change applies to NYSE Arca options market participants from June 22, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE American Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: NYSE American filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to raise certain manual options transaction fees for market makers from $0.50 to $1.00 per contract and add a $0.20 per contract rebate for floor broker orders trading with market maker orders on the trading floor. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing; market participants should review the fee schedule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE Texas filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to update its connectivity fee schedule for third-party data feeds. The change renames and reorganizes certain Cboe feeds, adds an IEX feed, and is expected to be operative by 2026-08-31. The SEC published the notice to solicit comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt FINRA Rule 4321 (Allocations of Fail To Deliver Positions) and Amend FINRA Rule 4560 (Short-Interest Reporting)
summary: The SEC extended its review period for FINRA’s proposed rule change to create FINRA Rule 4321 on allocations of fail-to-deliver positions and to amend FINRA Rule 4560 on short-interest reporting. This is not yet a final rule. The Commission must act by 2026-08-14 on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend a Continued Listing Standard Relating to Beneficial Holders Applicable to ETF Shares Listed on the Exchange Under Rule 17.104(b)(2)(B)
summary: The SEC is inviting comments on a Texas Stock Exchange proposal to amend its ETF continued-listing standard by eliminating the beneficial-holders test and renumbering the rule. This affects ETF Shares listed on TXSE, but it is not yet binding. No closing date is stated in the excerpt provided.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain Initial and Continued Listing Standards
summary: NYSE Texas filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its initial and continued listing standards, including definitions and quantitative thresholds for listed securities. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing. This affects issuers seeking or maintaining a listing on NYSE Texas; no direct obligation applies yet beyond the filing and comment process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; BOX Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Review of Professional Orders
summary: BOX Exchange filed a proposed rule change that would shorten the review and reclassification of “Professional” options orders from quarterly to monthly. Participants would need to represent eligible customers as Professional orders for the next calendar month, with related review and designation timing codified in the exchange rulebook. No specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; National Securities Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Enhance the Supplemental Liquidity Deposit Rules, Methodology and Processes
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on an NSCC proposed rule change to enhance supplemental liquidity deposit rules, methodology and processes. The proposal would standardize intraday liquidity calculations, add more detail on factors used to set obligations, and codify member reporting/information duties. It is not yet binding; comments are invited on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the By-Laws To Establish the Role of Observers
summary: MIAX filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to amend its by-laws to create a new Observer role on the board, including Observer rights and nomination process, and to remove outdated ERP and initial committee text. It is a notice and proposal, not a final rule. Comments are being solicited; no in-force date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt a Policy Relating to the Exchange's Treatment of Trade Reports
summary: NYSE Texas filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to adopt a policy for marking trade reports that it deems inconsistent with the prevailing market, using an Aberrant Report Indicator. The SEC is soliciting comments, but the filing is already effective under exchange rule procedures. The change affects market participants and data recipients for trade reporting and price metrics.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change by To Amend the By-Laws To Establish the Role of Observers
summary: MIAX PEARL filed an immediately effective proposed rule change with the SEC to amend its By-Laws, creating a new Observer role for the Board and removing obsolete ERP-related text. The notice solicits public comments on the filing. No firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on extending the information collection for Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1. It asks for comments by 2026-09-04 but does not change substantive obligations or filing requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 0-1 Under the Investment Company Act of 1940, Definition of Terms Used in This Part
summary: The SEC is requesting comments on the Paperwork Reduction Act extension for Rule 0-1 under the Investment Company Act. The notice concerns existing recordkeeping and board-minute requirements tied to independent legal counsel determinations for funds; it does not itself change the rule. No compliance date is set, but funds and their boards may wish to comment.

title: Blue Tractor ETF Trust, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Blue Tractor ETF Trust and Blue Tractor Group, LLC to amend a prior exemptive order so the funds can invest in a broader range of instruments. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final rule or binding requirement.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of proposed nonbanking activities for a bank holding company under section 4 of the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on Brookfield Bancshares’ proposal to continue extending credit and servicing loans by 2026-07-22. This is a public notice and comment item, not a rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the applications by 2026-08-06. The notice concerns proposed acquisitions in Oklahoma and Texas and does not itself approve any transaction.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisitions/retention of voting shares in a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-22. This is a notice, not a rule or decision.

title: Interest Rate Paid on Cash Deposited To Secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Immigration Bonds
summary: Treasury set the quarterly interest rate on cash deposited to secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement immigration bonds at 3% per annum for the period July 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026. This is a published rate notice for the stated period and does not impose a broader new rule for banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Partial Amendment No. 1 to Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 2210 (Communications With the Public)
summary: SEC notice seeking comment on FINRA’s Partial Amendment No. 1 to a proposed rule change for FINRA Rule 2210. The amendment would allow members, subject to conditions, to project performance or provide targeted returns in public communications. This is a consultation only; no immediate rule change or compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Relating To Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange's Rules Governing Security Futures Product Listing Standards, Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.'s Rules Governing Security Futures Adjustments, and Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.'s Rules Governing Cash-Settled Single Stock Security Futures
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on CME’s proposed rule change to add listing standards and adjustments for cash-settled single-stock security futures, including a new Chapter 711 and revised Chapter 700/701 rules. It affects CME and market participants trading these products. No compliance date is stated; the notice is for immediate effectiveness and consultation.

title: Muzinich Aviation Income Fund (mAIR) and Muzinich & Co., Inc.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Muzinich Aviation Income Fund and Muzinich & Co. seeking exemptive relief under the Investment Company Act to allow multiple share classes, distribution/service fees, early withdrawal charges, and related relief. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. No obligations are created by the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC and NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Changes Concerning the Single Component Concentration Limit of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to NYSE American and NYSE Arca rule changes that raise the MSCI Emerging Markets Index single-component concentration limit for EM Options from 15% to 20%. This allows continued listing and trading of those options and avoids a potential delisting issue. The change applies immediately upon approval; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 to a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain Parts of Its Opening and Closing Auctions
summary: The SEC is publishing a notice of a revised proposed rule change by Texas Stock Exchange LLC for comments. The filing would amend TXSE opening and closing auction rules, including late order handling, order modification cutoffs, auction information dissemination, and tie-break procedures. No compliance date is set yet; the comment/approval process remains open until the SEC acts by July 28, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 2900 Regarding Information Circular Requirements
summary: MIAX PEARL filed a proposed rule change to amend Rule 2900 on information circular requirements for UTP exchange-traded products. It would remove a duplicate pre-trading circular requirement, add cross-references, and change timing/form requirements for written descriptions. The SEC is seeking comments; no compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules 5.32-O and 5.35-O
summary: The SEC is publishing a comment request on NYSE Arca’s proposed rule change to amend FLEX Options rules, including expanding cash settlement eligibility to up to 50 non-ETF FLEX Equity Options and changing the selection metric from average daily volume to average daily notional value. This is a proposal only; comments are being solicited and no immediate compliance date is set.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 903G and 906G
summary: The SEC has published a notice of NYSE American’s proposed rule change to amend FLEX Options Rules 903G and 906G. The proposal would expand cash settlement eligibility to certain non-ETF FLEX equity options and change the selection metric from highest average daily volume to highest average daily notional value. Comments are being solicited; no compliance date is set in the text.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change to Except Accounts Pursuant to Section 530A of the Internal Revenue Code From the Requirements of FINRA Rule 3210 (Accounts At Other Broker-Dealers and Financial Institutions)
summary: The SEC published notice that FINRA has filed a non-controversial proposed rule change to exempt accounts under new Internal Revenue Code Section 530A from FINRA Rule 3210. It invites comments but does not itself change requirements. The filing relates to broker-dealers and their associated persons.

title: Goehring & Rozencwajg Investment Funds and Goehring & Rozencwajg Associates, LLC
summary: SEC notice announcing an application for exemptive relief for Goehring & Rozencwajg Investment Funds to operate a multi-class ETF structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final rule or order.

title: No Adjustment to Civil Monetary Penalty Amounts
summary: The SEC published a notice saying there will be no 2026 inflation increase to its civil monetary penalty amounts. The January 2025 penalty levels will continue to apply to penalties under the Securities Act, Exchange Act, Investment Company Act, Investment Advisers Act, and certain Sarbanes-Oxley penalties.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice inviting comments on a proposed change in bank control involving the Regan Family Control Group’s planned acquisition of shares in PB Bancshares, Inc. and Premier Bank in Minnesota. Comments are due by 2026-07-23. This is a notice about an ownership-control application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is requesting comments on a proposed three-year extension, without revision, of the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (FR 3077). Comments are due by 2026-09-08. This is an information collection notice, not a new rule or obligation for firms.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend, with revision, the FR 3016 Ongoing Intermittent Survey of Households for three years. The changes are effective immediately if approved and include moving from phone interviews to a web questionnaire and increasing the sample size to 1,150 households. Comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a bank holding company application by Nebraska Bankshares and its subsidiary to acquire Foundations First Corporation and indirectly acquire Foundation One Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-10. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend, for three years without revision, the information collection tied to CFPB Regulation DD disclosures. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. The notice affects state member banks, certain branches of foreign banks, commercial lending companies owned or controlled by foreign banks, and section 25 organizations.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend for three years, with revision, its Ad Hoc Clearance for Board-Wide Use (FR 3100). The proposal would reduce anticipated surveys from 20 to 10, and comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is requesting comment on a proposal to extend, with revision, its employment application information collection (FR 28) for three years under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. The notice covers Board job applicant forms, including optional self-identification and conflict-of-interest screening materials.

title: Community Development Revolving Loan Fund
summary: NCUA issued a notice of funding opportunity for the Community Development Revolving Loan Fund, offering revolving loan awards to eligible low-income-designated credit unions. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, the notice is effective on publication, and NCUA expects to notify applicants after about 180 calendar days. Credit unions must meet NCUA eligibility and application requirements, including SAM registration and an EIN.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Notice of Qualified Equity Investment for New Markets Credit
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form 8874-A, used by community development entities to notify taxpayers of a qualified equity investment for the New Markets Credit. There is no change to the underlying requirement; the comment deadline is 2026-09-08.

title: Prompt Payment Interest Rate; Contract Disputes Act
summary: The U.S. Treasury’s Fiscal Service set the prompt payment interest rate at 4.75% per annum for July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026. Federal agencies must use this rate when calculating late-payment interest penalties under the Prompt Payment Act and Contract Disputes Act for obligations accruing during that period.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the BondBloxx Private Credit Trust Under BZX Rule 14.11(f), Trust Issued Receipts
summary: The SEC has started proceedings on Cboe BZX’s proposal to list and trade shares of the BondBloxx Private Credit Trust under BZX’s Trust Issued Receipts rule. This does not itself approve or reject the product, but it moves the exchange filing into an opposition/decision phase. No firm deadline for firms is created in this notice, but the exchange must still await SEC action.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the LCH SA Liquidity Plan
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on LCH SA’s proposed change to its liquidity plan, which sets governance, procedures, and responsibilities for liquidity management at the clearing agency. The filing says implementation depends on SEC approval. It affects LCH SA and is subject to comment through the SEC notice process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Modify the GSD Rules To Adopt a U.S. Treasury Clearing Trade Submission Requirement
summary: The SEC has published FICC’s proposed rule change to require Netting Members to submit eligible U.S. Treasury secondary market transactions for clearing and settlement, and to add monitoring, self-reporting and disciplinary provisions. It is a proposal open for comment, not a final requirement. It affects FICC Netting Members and aligns the GSD rules with the SEC’s Treasury clearing standards.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MX2 LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 2.13, Application Process and Waive-In
summary: The SEC published a notice of MX2 LLC’s proposed rule change to make its waive-in membership application process available on an ongoing basis, rather than only for the now-expired post-approval window. Eligible applicants would still need to meet existing membership standards and file the prescribed application. Comments are being solicited; the proposal is not yet final.

title: Datum One Series Trust and Polar Capital LLP
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and Polar Capital LLP seeking exemptive relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure combining exchange-traded and mutual fund share classes. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of a request, not a rule or order.

title: Datum One Series Trust and First Sentier Investors (US) LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and First Sentier Investors (US) LLC seeking exemptive relief to operate a multi-class ETF structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or order, so it creates no immediate obligations.

title: Datum One Series Trust and Brandes Investment Partners, L.P.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and Brandes Investment Partners seeking exemptive relief to operate a multi-class ETF structure combining an ETF class with mutual fund classes. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final order or rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form 20-F
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a proposed extension of the existing Form 20-F information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Foreign private issuers using Form 20-F would continue to file annual or transition reports, and comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Revenue Procedure 2014-49
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection tied to Revenue Procedure 2014-49, which concerns low-income housing tax credit guidance for state housing credit agencies and owners after presidentially declared disasters. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. No substantive rule change is made.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend PIXL
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its PIXL options auction rules, removing price from the PIXL Auction Notification so only side, size and options series are disseminated. The exchange plans to implement the change on or before 2026-07-15 and says the SEC is soliciting comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Long-Term Stock Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend LTSE Rule 11.410(a) by Adding the Texas Stock Exchange LLC and Changing Nasdaq BX, LLC to Nasdaq Texas, LLC
summary: LTSE filed an immediately effective rule change to update Rule 11.410(a) so its data-feed list adds Texas Stock Exchange LLC and renames Nasdaq BX, LLC to Nasdaq Texas, LLC. The filing is effective under SEC Rule 19b-4(f)(6) and is open for Commission/public comment. It affects LTSE and other market participants using its order handling and surveillance rules.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change by Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC Amend Rule 612, Aggregate Risk Manager (ARM), To Adopt a New Origin Multiplier To Be Used When Calculating a Market Maker's Option Percentage
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on MIAX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 612 (Aggregate Risk Manager) by adding a new Origin Multiplier used to calculate a market maker’s option percentage. The change affects MIAX market makers and their risk controls; no firm deadline is stated in the notice, but the proposal is open for comment.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company proposals to engage in or acquire companies involved in permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the listed proposal by 2026-08-12. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change, and applies to the named bank holding company activity in the United States.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications, including OppFi, Inc.’s proposed acquisition of BNCCORP and indirect acquisition of BNC National Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-12. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Inflation Adjustments for Civil Money Penalties
summary: The Federal Reserve Board says its civil money penalty amounts will not increase for 2026 and that the 2025 penalty levels in 12 CFR 263.65 remain in effect. This is a notice only and does not impose a new filing or compliance deadline.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on U.S. Information Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on its information collection for U.S. information returns and related forms, under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-11. The notice discusses burden estimation methodology and OMB control number administration, but does not itself impose new requirements.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Interagency Guidance on Lending to Individuals Not Legally Authorized to Work in the United States
summary: The FDIC, OCC and NCUA issued interagency guidance for supervised financial institutions on lending to individuals not legally authorized to work in the United States. It reminds institutions to apply existing credit risk management obligations. It applies to all FDIC-supervised institutions and was published on 2026-07-13.

title: Dawson Private Markets Evergreen Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC issued a notice of an application for exemptive relief allowing certain BDCs and open- and closed-end funds to co-invest in portfolio companies with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-03. This is a notice only; it does not itself change requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for July 16, 2026. The notice gives the time, place and general subjects to be discussed, including enforcement and litigation matters, but it does not create any new obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the CDS Instrument On-Boarding Policies and Procedures
primary_functions: Product; Risk; Operational resilience; Compliance; Regulatory change
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on ICE Clear Credit’s proposed rule change to its CDS instrument on-boarding policy. ICC would add a new criterion for considering single-name CDS instruments based on minimum outstanding debt notional, while keeping the change subject to Commission approval before it takes effect. No firm action is required yet, but clearing participants and related risk/governance teams should review the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 100, Definitions, To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX Sapphire’s proposed rule change to shorten the review of customer order activity from quarterly to monthly for Professional Interest/Priority Customer designations. Members would need to review customer activity each month and update order classifications for the next month. Comments are being solicited; the change is proposed but not yet final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Clarify Language Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change to clarify its fee schedule so the free trial periods for its 1-minute and 10-minute Intraday Open-Close Historical Data products are separate and independent. The filing was published by the SEC for comment and became immediately effective on filing. It affects TPHs and non-TPHs using those data products; no implementation date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Clearance of Additional Credit Default Swap Contracts
summary: The SEC published a notice extending the time to act on ICE Clear Credit LLC’s proposed rule change to clear additional credit default swap contracts. The Commission sets August 25, 2026 as the new deadline to approve, disapprove, or start disapproval proceedings.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: MIAX Emerald filed a proposed rule change, immediately effective but subject to SEC notice-and-comment, to shorten the review of Professional Interest orders from quarterly to monthly. Members would have to review customer activity each month and update order designations within five days after month-end. The change applies to MIAX Emerald members trading listed options.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18-E Regarding Regulatory Halts for Corporate Actions and Issuer-Related Events
summary: NYSE Arca filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.18-E on regulatory halts and trading resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions and issuer-related events. The change is intended to support 23/5 trading and clarify when trading will be halted and reopened via a Trading Halt Auction. No filing deadline is stated in the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Relating to ICC's Fee Schedule
summary: ICE Clear Credit has filed a proposed change to its CDS client fee schedule, increasing discount levels under its Client Volume Incentive Program and adding a 100% discount above $6.94 million in annual billed fees. The change is immediately effective but will not be implemented until certified under CFTC Regulation 40.6. It applies to client clearing activity for ICC CDS clients.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Permit VIX Future-Option Orders
summary: The SEC extended its review period for Cboe Exchange’s proposed rule change to permit VIX future-option orders. The Commission must now approve or disapprove the filing by 2026-09-13. This is a procedural notice about a pending exchange rule, not a final requirement.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 4120 Regarding Regulatory Halts for Corporate Actions and Issuer-Related Events
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to amend Rule 4120 on regulatory halts and resumption of trading for securities subject to certain corporate actions and issuer-related events. It would apply to securities primarily listed on Nasdaq and is intended to support 23/5 trading. No compliance date is stated, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 100, Definitions, To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: MIAX filed and made immediately effective a rule change to amend Rule 100 so members must review and reclassify customer orders monthly, not quarterly, for Professional Interest/Priority Customer treatment. Members must complete the review and any changes within five days after each calendar month-end.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a notice updating the identifying information for one or more persons on the SDN List. The updated listing continues the U.S. asset-freeze/blocking effect for persons whose property is subject to U.S. jurisdiction. Firms dealing with sanctions screening, payments, onboarding and customer remediation should update controls immediately.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Gold & Silver Products
summary: The U.S. Mint announced 2026 retail prices for three Freedom Ringing—Liberty Bell gold and silver products. This is an informational pricing notice for Mint products, with no compliance action or regulatory requirement for banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Suspension of and Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove the Proposed Rule Change To Amend the DTC Operational Arrangements (Necessary for Securities To Become and Remain Eligible for DTC Services)
summary: The SEC issued a notice suspending and instituting proceedings on DTC’s proposed rule change to update its operational arrangements for ATOP/ASOP agents and related corporate action processing. It is not the rule itself and does not create new requirements, but it signals continued review of the proposal and received comments. No compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule for Its Complex Order Book Data Feed
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Cboe Exchange proposal to amend its fee schedule for the Complex Order Book data feed, including expanding the Retail Broker Waiver Program to waive Internal Distributor Fees. This affects Cboe Options distributors and retail brokers; the filing is immediately effective but still open to SEC review and comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Partial Amendment No. 1 and Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, to Exempt Specified Collective Trust Funds From FINRA Rules 5130 (Restrictions on the Purchase and Sale of Initial Public Offerings) and 5131(b) (New Issue Allocations and Distributions)
summary: The SEC issued an order instituting proceedings on FINRA’s proposed rule change to exempt specified collective trust funds from FINRA new-issue rules 5130 and 5131(b), and is soliciting comments.
